first_action.text: Remove the weed Oxalis, which carries the rust, from in and around the field; next season, grow a resistant hybrid.

texts.bn: মরচে রোগ বহনকারী Oxalis আগাছা জমির ভেতর ও চারপাশ থেকে তুলে ফেলুন। পরের মরসুমে প্রতিরোধী সংকর জাত লাগান।
texts.gu: ગેરુ ફેલાવતું Oxalis નીંદણ ખેતરમાં અને આસપાસથી કાઢી નાખો; આવતી સીઝનમાં પ્રતિકારક હાઇબ્રિડ વાવો.
texts.hi: रतुआ फैलाने वाला खरपतवार Oxalis खेत के अंदर और आसपास से हटाएं। अगले मौसम में प्रतिरोधी संकर किस्म लगाएं।
texts.kn: ತುಕ್ಕು ರೋಗ ಹರಡುವ Oxalis ಕಳೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊಲದ ಒಳಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸುತ್ತಲೂ ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂಗಾಮಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿರೋಧಕ ಹೈಬ್ರಿಡ್ ಬೆಳೆಯಿರಿ.
texts.ml: തുരുമ്പ് രോഗം വഹിക്കുന്ന Oxalis കള വയലിനകത്തും ചുറ്റും നിന്ന് നീക്കുക; അടുത്ത സീസണിൽ രോഗം ചെറുക്കുന്ന ഹൈബ്രിഡ് നടുക.
texts.mr: तांबेरा पसरवणारे Oxalis हे तण शेतात आणि आजूबाजूला काढा. पुढच्या हंगामात प्रतिकारक संकरित वाण लावा.
texts.or: ମରିଚା ବହନ କରୁଥିବା Oxalis ଘାସକୁ ଜମି ଭିତରୁ ଓ ଚାରିପାଖରୁ ବାହାର କରନ୍ତୁ; ଆସନ୍ତା ମରସୁମରେ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧୀ ହାଇବ୍ରିଡ୍ ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਕੁੰਗੀ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਂਭਣ ਵਾਲੇ Oxalis ਨਦੀਨ ਨੂੰ ਖੇਤ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰੋਂ ਅਤੇ ਆਲੇ-ਦੁਆਲਿਓਂ ਕੱਢ ਦਿਓ; ਅਗਲੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੋਧਕ ਹਾਈਬ੍ਰਿਡ ਲਾਓ।
texts.ta: துருவைச் சுமக்கும் Oxalis களையை வயலுக்குள்ளும் சுற்றிலும் இருந்து அகற்றுங்கள். அடுத்த பருவத்தில் எதிர்ப்புத் திறன் உள்ள வீரிய ரகத்தைப் பயிரிடுங்கள்.
texts.te: తుప్పు తెగులును మోసే Oxalis కలుపును పొలంలో, పొలం చుట్టూ తీసేయండి. వచ్చే సీజన్‌లో తట్టుకునే హైబ్రిడ్ రకం వేయండి.

symptoms: Small, slightly oval, water-soaked spots appear on the leaves early on.
These spots grow into long, spindle-shaped dead areas.
The spots start on the lower leaves and spread as the plant grows.
Eventually, the entire leaf surface looks like it has been burned.

discriminators.question: Are the spots long and spindle or cigar shaped, greyish green to tan, starting on the lower leaves?
Are the spots small and diamond shaped at first, then a little longer, tan with a buff to brown border?
Are there small raised brown bumps (pustules) on both sides of the leaf?

diseases.favourable_conditions: The disease causes significant damage when infection happens at the silking stage under optimum conditions.
prevention: Use resistant or tolerant varieties like PEMH-5, Vivek 21, Vivek 23, Vivek 25, or Nithyashree.
Pull out and remove plants that are badly affected.
practices: Monitor the crop for the first signs of the disease.
Pull out and destroy badly affected plants as soon as you see them.

first_action.text: Count first: act at 10% of plants with leaf blight. Pull out and destroy badly affected plants.

texts.bn: আগে গুনে দেখুন: 10% গাছে পাতা ঝলসানো রোগ থাকলে ব্যবস্থা নিন। খুব আক্রান্ত গাছ তুলে নষ্ট করুন।
texts.gu: પહેલા ગણતરી કરો: 10% છોડમાં પાનનો સૂકારો હોય તો પગલાં લો. ખૂબ અસરગ્રસ્ત છોડ ઉખેડીને નાશ કરો.
texts.hi: पहले गिनती करें: 10% पौधों में पत्ती झुलसा हो तब उपाय करें। बहुत रोगी पौधे उखाड़कर नष्ट करें।
texts.kn: ಮೊದಲು ಎಣಿಸಿ: 10% ಗಿಡಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲೆ ಅಂಗಮಾರಿ ಇದ್ದರೆ ಕ್ರಮ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಿ. ತುಂಬಾ ಬಾಧಿತ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಕಿತ್ತು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ.
texts.ml: ആദ്യം എണ്ണിനോക്കുക: 10% ചെടികളിൽ ഇലകരിച്ചിൽ ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ നടപടി എടുക്കുക. വളരെ ബാധിച്ച ചെടികൾ പിഴുതെടുത്ത് നശിപ്പിക്കുക.
texts.mr: आधी मोजणी करा: 10% झाडांवर पानांचा करपा असेल तर उपाय करा. खूप बाधित झाडे उपटून नष्ट करा.
texts.or: ପ୍ରଥମେ ଗଣନା କରନ୍ତୁ: 10% ଗଛରେ ପତ୍ର ଝଲସା ରୋଗ ଥିଲେ ପ୍ରତିକାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ବହୁତ ରୋଗାକ୍ରାନ୍ତ ଗଛ ଉପାଡ଼ି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਕਰੋ: 10% ਬੂਟਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੱਤਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਝੁਲਸ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਇਲਾਜ ਕਰੋ। ਬਹੁਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਿਤ ਬੂਟੇ ਪੁੱਟ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ।
texts.ta: முதலில் எண்ணுங்கள்: 10% செடிகளில் இலைக் கருகல் இருந்தால் நடவடிக்கை எடுங்கள். மிகவும் பாதித்த செடிகளைப் பிடுங்கி அழியுங்கள்.
texts.te: ముందు లెక్కపెట్టండి: 10% మొక్కలకు ఆకులు మాడే తెగులు ఉంటే చర్య తీసుకోండి. బాగా సోకిన మొక్కలను పీకి నాశనం చేయండి.

etl.text: 10% of plants affected by leaf blight.

diseases.pathogen: Bipolaris maydis, Drechslera maydis, H. maydis
symptoms: Young spots on the leaves are small and shaped like diamonds.
As the spots grow older, they stretch out and get longer.
The spots can join together to cover large parts of the leaf.
When spots join, they make the leaf look like it has been burned.
The size and shape of the spots can change depending on the type of maize you grow.

discriminators.question: Are the spots long and spindle or cigar shaped, greyish green to tan, starting on the lower leaves?
Are the spots small and diamond shaped at first, then a little longer, tan with a buff to brown border?
Are the spots narrow and rectangular, stopped by the veins on both sides, tan turning grey?

prevention: Choose resistant maize varieties to plant in your field.
Do not use seeds that came from fields already infected with the disease.
practices: Check your fields regularly for signs of the disease.
Remove and destroy any plants that show signs of infection.
Rotate your maize with other types of crops.

etl.text: 10% of plants affected by leaf blight.

symptoms: Spots first show up on the lower leaves, about two to three weeks before the tassels come out.
The spots are long and narrow, up to about 5 cm, rectangular and light tan in colour.
Later the spots turn grey.
The spots are held in by the leaf veins, and many spots can join together and kill whole leaves.

discriminators.question: Are the spots narrow and rectangular, stopped by the veins on both sides, tan turning grey?

diseases.favourable_conditions: Warm weather (around 27 to 32 degrees Celsius) with very humid air, above 90 percent for 12 hours or more, favours it, and it is worse where maize follows maize.
prevention: Grow a resistant hybrid where one is available.
Rotate maize with other crops, because the fungus survives in old maize residue.
Tilling in the old residue reduces how much of the fungus survives.
practices: Look at the lower leaves first, because the spots start there and move upwards.
After harvest, plough in old maize residue and avoid planting maize again in the same field next season.

sources.title: Crop Protection Network (US land-grant universities): Gray leaf spot of corn

first_action.text: Look at the lower leaves first; after harvest, plough in old maize residue and do not plant maize again in the same field next season.

texts.bn: আগে নিচের পাতা দেখুন। ফসল কাটার পর ভুট্টার পুরোনো অবশেষ চাষ দিয়ে মাটিতে মিশিয়ে দিন এবং পরের মরসুমে একই জমিতে আবার ভুট্টা লাগাবেন না।
texts.gu: પહેલા નીચેના પાન જુઓ; લણણી પછી મકાઈના જૂના અવશેષ ખેડીને જમીનમાં દાટો અને આવતી સીઝનમાં એ જ ખેતરમાં ફરી મકાઈ ન વાવો.
texts.hi: पहले नीचे की पत्तियां देखें। कटाई के बाद मक्के के पुराने अवशेष खेत में जोत दें और अगले मौसम में उसी खेत में फिर मक्का न लगाएं।
texts.kn: ಮೊದಲು ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ. ಕೊಯ್ಲಿನ ನಂತರ ಹಳೆಯ ಮೆಕ್ಕೆಜೋಳದ ಅವಶೇಷವನ್ನು ಉಳುಮೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಮಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ, ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂಗಾಮಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅದೇ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಮೆಕ್ಕೆಜೋಳ ಬೆಳೆಯಬೇಡಿ.
texts.ml: ആദ്യം താഴത്തെ ഇലകൾ നോക്കുക; വിളവെടുപ്പിന് ശേഷം പഴയ ചോളത്തിന്റെ അവശിഷ്ടങ്ങൾ ഉഴുത് മണ്ണിൽ ചേർക്കുക, അടുത്ത സീസണിൽ അതേ വയലിൽ വീണ്ടും ചോളം നടരുത്.
texts.mr: आधी खालची पाने पाहा. कापणीनंतर मक्याचे जुने अवशेष नांगरून गाडा आणि पुढच्या हंगामात त्याच शेतात पुन्हा मका लावू नका.
texts.or: ପ୍ରଥମେ ତଳ ପତ୍ର ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ; ଅମଳ ପରେ ପୁରୁଣା ମକା ଅବଶେଷ ହଳ କରି ମାଟିରେ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଆସନ୍ତା ମରସୁମରେ ସେହି ଜମିରେ ପୁଣି ମକା ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।
texts.pa: ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੇਠਲੇ ਪੱਤੇ ਦੇਖੋ; ਵਾਢੀ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਮੱਕੀ ਦੀ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਰਹਿੰਦ-ਖੂੰਹਦ ਵਾਹ ਕੇ ਮਿੱਟੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੱਬੋ ਅਤੇ ਅਗਲੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਸੇ ਖੇਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੁਬਾਰਾ ਮੱਕੀ ਨਾ ਲਾਓ।
texts.ta: முதலில் கீழ் இலைகளைப் பாருங்கள். அறுவடைக்குப் பின் பழைய மக்காச்சோளக் கழிவுகளை உழுது மண்ணில் புதையுங்கள், அடுத்த பருவத்தில் அதே வயலில் மீண்டும் மக்காச்சோளம் நடாதீர்கள்.
texts.te: ముందు కింది ఆకులను చూడండి. కోత తర్వాత పాత మొక్కజొన్న వ్యర్థాలను దున్ని మట్టిలో కలిపేయండి. వచ్చే సీజన్‌లో అదే పొలంలో మళ్ళీ మొక్కజొన్న వేయవద్దు.

diseases.pathogen: Peronosclerospora sorghi, Scleropthora rayssiae var. zeae, Peronosclerospora hetropogoni
symptoms: The plant may look yellow and stunted.
You might see white stripes on the leaves.
A white fuzzy growth can appear on the leaf surfaces.
The tassels may look like leaves instead of flowers.
The plant may have trouble setting seeds properly.
Leaves can show yellow stripes that later turn purple or red.
diseases.favourable_conditions: The disease is often linked to planting before the rainy season begins.
prevention: Choose maize varieties that are known to be resistant to the disease.
Treat your seeds with recommended fungicides before planting.
Avoid planting maize next to sorghum fields to stop the disease from spreading.
Do not plant maize after sorghum in the same field.
practices: Walk through your field and pull out any sick plants as soon as you see them.
Destroy the infected plants you remove to stop the spread.
Monitor your crop closely for early signs of the disease.

avoid.text: Do not use carbendazim, or mixtures that contain it, for this disease: carbendazim does not work on water moulds (oomycetes) such as the downy mildew and late blight pathogens.

first_action.text: Pull out and destroy plants with downy mildew as soon as you see them, and do not plant maize next to sorghum.

texts.bn: ডাউনি মিলডিউ হওয়া গাছ দেখামাত্র তুলে নষ্ট করুন এবং জোয়ারের পাশে ভুট্টা লাগাবেন না।
texts.gu: ડાઉની મિલ્ડ્યુવાળા છોડ દેખાય કે તરત ઉખેડીને નાશ કરો અને જુવારની બાજુમાં મકાઈ ન વાવો.
texts.hi: मृदुरोमिल आसिता वाले पौधे दिखते ही उखाड़कर नष्ट करें और मक्का ज्वार के पास न लगाएं।
texts.kn: ಬೂದಿ ರೋಗ ಇರುವ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಕಂಡ ಕೂಡಲೇ ಕಿತ್ತು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ, ಜೋಳದ ಪಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೆಕ್ಕೆಜೋಳ ಬೆಳೆಯಬೇಡಿ.
texts.ml: ഡൗണി മിൽഡ്യൂ ബാധിച്ച ചെടികൾ കണ്ടാലുടൻ പിഴുതെടുത്ത് നശിപ്പിക്കുക, ചോളത്തിനടുത്ത് കമ്പ് നടരുത്.
texts.mr: केवडा झालेली झाडे दिसताच उपटून नष्ट करा आणि ज्वारीच्या शेजारी मका लावू नका.
texts.or: ଡାଉନି ମିଲ୍ଡ୍ୟୁ ଥିବା ଗଛ ଦେଖିବା ମାତ୍ରେ ଉପାଡ଼ି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଜୁଆର ପାଖରେ ମକା ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।
texts.pa: ਡਾਊਨੀ ਮਿਲਡਿਊ ਵਾਲੇ ਬੂਟੇ ਦਿਖਦੇ ਹੀ ਪੁੱਟ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਜਵਾਰ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਮੱਕੀ ਨਾ ਲਾਓ।
texts.ta: அடிச்சாம்பல் நோய் உள்ள செடிகளைக் கண்டவுடன் பிடுங்கி அழியுங்கள், சோளத்தின் அருகில் மக்காச்சோளம் நடாதீர்கள்.
texts.te: డౌనీ మిల్డ్యూ తెగులు సోకిన మొక్కలను కనిపించగానే పీకి నాశనం చేయండి. జొన్న పక్కన మొక్కజొన్న వేయవద్దు.

etl.text: 10% of plants affected.

symptoms: You may see long papery windows on the leaves of young plants.
The leaves develop ragged holes that get bigger as the pest grows.
Large areas of the leaves may be eaten away completely.
The pest may bore into the corn ears and damage them.
You might see a lot of waste matter left behind by the pests.
prevention: Plough your field deeply before planting to expose the pests to birds.
Plant your crops at the same time as your neighbors to avoid staggered growth.
Plant rows of pulse crops like pigeon pea or black gram between your maize.
Set up bird perches in the field to attract birds that eat the pests.
Plant trap crops like Napier grass around the edge of your field.
practices: Walk through your field in a W pattern every week to check for damage.
Pick off egg masses and larvae by hand and crush them or drop them in water.
Put a mix of sand and lime or ash into the center of the plant whorl.
Use pheromone traps to catch and destroy the male moths.
Monitor your crop regularly from the time it sprouts.

organic_bio.text: 5% Neem Seed Kernel emulsion (NSKE) or azadirachtin 1500ppm @ 5ml/l water
Nomuraea rileyi rice grain formulation (1 x 10^8 cfu/g) @ 3 g/l water
Beauveria bassiana and Verticillium lecanii at 1 x 10^8 CFU/g @ 5 g/litre
Trichogramma pretiosum and Telenomus remus @ 50000 per acre

first_action.text: Count first: walk the field in a W pattern; act at 10% damaged plants up to mid-whorl. Put sand mixed with lime or ash into the whorl.

texts.bn: আগে গুনে দেখুন: জমিতে W আকারে হেঁটে দেখুন। মাঝ-মোচা অবস্থা পর্যন্ত 10% গাছ নষ্ট হলে ব্যবস্থা নিন। চুন বা ছাই মেশানো বালি মোচার ভেতরে দিন।
texts.gu: પહેલા ગણતરી કરો: ખેતરમાં W આકારમાં ચાલીને જુઓ; અડધી ભૂંગળી સુધી 10% છોડને નુકસાન હોય તો પગલાં લો. ચૂના કે રાખ ભેળવેલી રેતી ભૂંગળીમાં નાખો.
texts.hi: पहले गिनती करें: खेत में W आकार में चलकर देखें। मध्य-पोंगली अवस्था तक 10% पौधे खराब हों तब उपाय करें। पोंगली में चूने या राख मिली रेत डालें।
texts.kn: ಮೊದಲು ಎಣಿಸಿ: ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ W ಆಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದು ನೋಡಿ. ಮಧ್ಯ ಸುರುಳಿ ಹಂತದವರೆಗೆ 10% ಗಿಡಗಳು ಹಾನಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ ಕ್ರಮ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಿ. ಸುಣ್ಣ ಅಥವಾ ಬೂದಿ ಬೆರೆಸಿದ ಮರಳನ್ನು ಸುರುಳಿಯೊಳಗೆ ಹಾಕಿ.
texts.ml: ആദ്യം എണ്ണിനോക്കുക: വയലിൽ W ആകൃതിയിൽ നടന്ന് നോക്കുക; പകുതി കൂമ്പ് വരെ 10% ചെടികൾ കേടായാൽ നടപടി എടുക്കുക. ചുണ്ണാമ്പോ ചാരമോ കലർത്തിയ മണൽ കൂമ്പിൽ ഇടുക.
texts.mr: आधी मोजणी करा: शेतात W आकारात चालत पाहणी करा. मध्य पोंग्याच्या अवस्थेपर्यंत 10% झाडे खराब असतील तर उपाय करा. पोंग्यात चुना किंवा राख मिसळलेली वाळू टाका.
texts.or: ପ୍ରଥମେ ଗଣନା କରନ୍ତୁ: ଜମିରେ W ଆକାରରେ ଚାଲି ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ; ମଝି ଗୁଳା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ 10% ଗଛ ନଷ୍ଟ ହେଲେ ପ୍ରତିକାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ଚୂନ ବା ପାଉଁଶ ମିଶା ବାଲି ଗୁଳା ଭିତରେ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਕਰੋ: ਖੇਤ ਵਿੱਚ W ਦੀ ਸ਼ਕਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੁਰ ਕੇ ਦੇਖੋ; ਅੱਧੀ ਗੋਭ ਤੱਕ 10% ਬੂਟੇ ਖਰਾਬ ਹੋਣ ਤਾਂ ਇਲਾਜ ਕਰੋ। ਚੂਨੇ ਜਾਂ ਸੁਆਹ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਿਲੀ ਰੇਤ ਗੋਭ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਓ।
texts.ta: முதலில் எண்ணுங்கள்: வயலில் W வடிவத்தில் நடந்து பாருங்கள். நடு குருத்து நிலை வரை 10% செடிகள் சேதமாக இருந்தால் நடவடிக்கை எடுங்கள். சுண்ணாம்பு அல்லது சாம்பல் கலந்த மணலை குருத்தில் போடுங்கள்.
texts.te: ముందు లెక్కపెట్టండి: పొలంలో W ఆకారంలో నడుస్తూ చూడండి. మొక్క సగం సుడి దశ వరకు 10% మొక్కలు దెబ్బతింటే చర్య తీసుకోండి. సున్నం లేదా బూడిద కలిపిన ఇసుకను మొక్క సుడిలో వేయండి.

etl.text: From seedling to mid-whorl stage, act when about 10% of plants are damaged (for example 2 out of 20 plants checked on a W-shaped walk). After mid-whorl, the same level does not call for a spray.

symptoms: Leaves are evenly green for the variety, with no spots, streaks, rings or powdery coating.
Leaf edges and tips are not curling, yellowing, drying or burnt.
There are no insects, eggs, webbing, holes or bore marks on the leaves, stems or fruits.
prevention: Choose a variety that resists or tolerates the main pests and diseases, and use healthy seed or planting material.
Treat seed or planting material before sowing, preferably with a bio-pesticide.
Keep proper spacing, give organic manure and fertiliser by soil test, and avoid too much nitrogen, which makes the crop soft and easy for pests and diseases to attack.
Water the crop properly and rotate crops from season to season.
practices: Walk through the field at least once a week and look at the soil, water, plants, pests and the friendly insects that eat pests.
Look after the friendly insects and spiders by avoiding broad-spectrum chemical sprays.
Act early when you see trouble, for example by collecting egg masses or removing infested plants.

symptoms: You will see small black spots mostly on the older leaves first.
These spots grow larger and show a bull's eye pattern of rings in the middle.
The leaf tissue around the spots often turns yellow.
Similar spots appear on stems and can wrap around the plant near the soil.
The fungus also infects the fruit, often starting where the stem attaches.
Large spots can cover almost the entire fruit with visible rings.

discriminators.question: Do the brown spots have rings inside them like a target, mostly on the older lower leaves?
Are there dark water-soaked patches that spread fast, with white fuzz on the underside in damp weather?
Are there many small round spots with a grey centre and dark edge, without rings inside?

diseases.favourable_conditions: Warm, rainy and wet weather helps the disease spread.
prevention: Change the location of your nursery beds every season.
Remove all weeds and volunteer tomato plants from the area.
Ask your local agricultural office about using resistant or tolerant plant varieties.
Make sure to fertilize your plants properly.
practices: Remove and destroy all crop debris from the field.
Practice crop rotation to help lower the chance of disease.
Monitor your plants regularly for early signs of spots.

first_action.text: Remove and destroy the lower spotted leaves and old crop waste; next season, rotate the crop and move the nursery.

texts.bn: নিচের দাগ পড়া পাতা ও পুরোনো ফসলের অবশেষ তুলে নষ্ট করুন। পরের মরসুমে ফসলের আবর্তন করুন এবং বীজতলার জায়গা বদলান।
texts.gu: નીચેના ડાઘવાળા પાન અને જૂનો પાકનો કચરો કાઢીને નાશ કરો; આવતી સીઝનમાં પાકની ફેરબદલી કરો અને ધરુવાડિયાની જગ્યા બદલો.
texts.hi: नीचे की धब्बेदार पत्तियां और पुराने फसल अवशेष हटाकर नष्ट करें। अगले मौसम में फसल चक्र अपनाएं और नर्सरी की जगह बदलें।
texts.kn: ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಚುಕ್ಕೆ ಬಿದ್ದ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಹಳೆಯ ಬೆಳೆ ತ್ಯಾಜ್ಯವನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂಗಾಮಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆ ಸರದಿ ಮಾಡಿ, ಸಸಿಮಡಿಯ ಜಾಗ ಬದಲಿಸಿ.
texts.ml: താഴത്തെ പുള്ളിയുള്ള ഇലകളും പഴയ വിള അവശിഷ്ടങ്ങളും നീക്കി നശിപ്പിക്കുക; അടുത്ത സീസണിൽ വിള മാറ്റി കൃഷി ചെയ്യുകയും ഞാറ്റടി സ്ഥലം മാറ്റുകയും ചെയ്യുക.
texts.mr: खालची ठिपके पडलेली पाने आणि जुने पिकाचे अवशेष काढून नष्ट करा. पुढच्या हंगामात पीक फेरपालट करा आणि रोपवाटिकेची जागा बदला.
texts.or: ତଳର ଦାଗ ଥିବା ପତ୍ର ଓ ପୁରୁଣା ଫସଲ ଅବଶେଷ ବାହାର କରି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଆସନ୍ତା ମରସୁମରେ ଫସଲ ଘୂର୍ଣ୍ଣନ କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ ନର୍ସରୀ ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਹੇਠਲੇ ਧੱਬਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਪੱਤੇ ਅਤੇ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਫ਼ਸਲ ਦੀ ਰਹਿੰਦ-ਖੂੰਹਦ ਕੱਢ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ; ਅਗਲੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਫ਼ਸਲ ਦਾ ਫੇਰ-ਬਦਲ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਪਨੀਰੀ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਬਦਲੋ।
texts.ta: கீழ் உள்ள புள்ளி விழுந்த இலைகளையும் பழைய பயிர்க் கழிவுகளையும் அகற்றி அழியுங்கள். அடுத்த பருவத்தில் பயிர் சுழற்சி செய்து நாற்றங்காலை இடம் மாற்றுங்கள்.
texts.te: కింది మచ్చలున్న ఆకులను, పాత పంట వ్యర్థాలను తీసి నాశనం చేయండి. వచ్చే సీజన్‌లో పంట మార్పిడి చేయండి, నారుమడిని వేరే చోటికి మార్చండి.

symptoms: You will see small, irregular, water-soaked spots on the leaves.
These spots turn dark brown and may have white fuzz underneath.
The stems develop dark, greasy-looking patches that can kill the plant.
Fruits show sunken brown spots that may develop white mold.
Dark, greasy spots can also appear on the fruit.
Brown streaks may appear on the stems and leaf stalks.

discriminators.question: Do the brown spots have rings inside them like a target, mostly on the older lower leaves?
Are there dark water-soaked patches that spread fast, with white fuzz on the underside in damp weather?

diseases.favourable_conditions: The disease spreads quickly in cool, humid weather with temperatures between 15 and 18 degrees Celsius and high humidity.
prevention: Choose resistant tomato varieties like Arka Abhed F1.
Rotate your crops so you do not plant tomatoes in the same field every year.
Ensure there is enough space between plants to allow for good airflow.
Use black plastic mulch to keep the soil dry and stop the disease from spreading.
Avoid overhead watering and improve your field drainage.
practices: Check your plants regularly for any signs of the disease.
Remove and destroy any plant parts that look infected.
Use stakes to keep plants off the ground and improve airflow.
Improve field drainage and avoid watering over the leaves.

Do not use the same type of fungicide again and again. For strobilurin (QoI) fungicides such as azoxystrobin used alone, use no more than 1 spray in 3, at most 3 per crop and never more than 2 in a row; switch to a fungicide of a different group in between.

avoid.text: Do not use carbendazim, or mixtures that contain it, for this disease: carbendazim does not work on water moulds (oomycetes) such as the downy mildew and late blight pathogens.

first_action.text: Remove and destroy infected leaves and fruits at once, stake the plants for air flow and avoid watering over the leaves.

texts.bn: আক্রান্ত পাতা ও ফল সঙ্গে সঙ্গে তুলে নষ্ট করুন, বাতাস চলাচলের জন্য গাছে খুঁটি দিয়ে বাঁধুন এবং পাতার উপর জল দেবেন না।
texts.gu: રોગવાળા પાન અને ફળ તરત કાઢીને નાશ કરો, હવાની અવરજવર માટે છોડને ટેકો આપો અને પાન પર પાણી ન છાંટો.
texts.hi: रोगी पत्तियां और फल तुरंत हटाकर नष्ट करें, हवा के लिए पौधों को सहारा देकर बांधें और पत्तियों के ऊपर से पानी न दें।
texts.kn: ರೋಗಪೀಡಿತ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಯಿಗಳನ್ನು ತಕ್ಷಣ ತೆಗೆದು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ, ಗಾಳಿ ಆಡಲು ಗಿಡಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೋಲು ಕಟ್ಟಿ, ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ನೀರು ಹಾಕಬೇಡಿ.
texts.ml: രോഗം ബാധിച്ച ഇലകളും കായ്കളും ഉടൻ നീക്കി നശിപ്പിക്കുക, വായുസഞ്ചാരത്തിന് ചെടികൾക്ക് താങ്ങ് നൽകുക, ഇലകൾക്ക് മുകളിലൂടെ നനയ്ക്കരുത്.
texts.mr: रोगट पाने आणि फळे लगेच काढून नष्ट करा, हवा खेळती राहावी म्हणून झाडांना काठीचा आधार द्या आणि पानांवर पाणी देऊ नका.
texts.or: ରୋଗାକ୍ରାନ୍ତ ପତ୍ର ଓ ଫଳ ତୁରନ୍ତ ବାହାର କରି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ, ପବନ ଚଳାଚଳ ପାଇଁ ଗଛରେ ଖୁଣ୍ଟ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ପତ୍ର ଉପରେ ପାଣି ଢାଳନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।
texts.pa: ਬਿਮਾਰ ਪੱਤੇ ਅਤੇ ਫਲ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਕੱਢ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ, ਹਵਾ ਲੰਘਣ ਲਈ ਬੂਟਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਹਾਰਾ ਦਿਓ ਅਤੇ ਪੱਤਿਆਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾ ਪਾਓ।
texts.ta: நோய் பாதித்த இலைகளையும் பழங்களையும் உடனே அகற்றி அழியுங்கள், காற்றோட்டத்திற்காக செடிகளுக்குக் குச்சி கட்டுங்கள், இலைகளின் மேல் தண்ணீர் ஊற்றாதீர்கள்.
texts.te: తెగులు సోకిన ఆకులను, కాయలను వెంటనే తీసి నాశనం చేయండి. గాలి తగిలేలా మొక్కలకు కర్రలు కట్టండి. ఆకులపై నీరు పోయవద్దు.

resistance_note.text: Do not use the same type of fungicide again and again. For strobilurin (QoI) fungicides such as azoxystrobin used alone, use no more than 1 spray in 3, at most 3 per crop and never more than 2 in a row; switch to a fungicide of a different group in between.

symptoms: New plant growth looks stunted with short stems.
New leaves are small, wrinkled, and yellow between the veins.
Leaf edges curl upward to look like a cup.
Flowers may form but often fall off before fruit grows.
Older leaves become leathery and brittle.
Infected plants look pale and bushy with many side branches.
diseases.favourable_conditions: Warm weather conditions are favourable for multiplication.
prevention: Grow resistant or tolerant plant varieties.
Raise seedlings in a protected nursery covered with a fine net to keep whiteflies out.
Plant barrier crops like cereals or maize around the field.
Remove weeds that can host the virus.
practices: Use yellow sticky traps to monitor whitefly numbers.
Collect and destroy all infected plant parts and debris.
Keep the field clean and free of weeds.
Follow good crop rotation practices with non-host crops.

organic_bio.text: Spray neem seed kernel extract (NSKE) 5% @ 80 g in 160 l of water/acre
Spray azadirachtin 5% W/W neem extract concentrate @ 80 g in 160 l of water/acre

first_action.text: Pull out and destroy curled plants early, and control whiteflies with yellow sticky traps; next season, raise seedlings under fine net.

texts.bn: কোঁকড়ানো গাছ আগেভাগে তুলে নষ্ট করুন এবং হলুদ আঠালো ফাঁদ দিয়ে সাদা মাছি দমন করুন। পরের মরসুমে চারা মিহি জালের নিচে তৈরি করুন।
texts.gu: વળી ગયેલા છોડ વહેલા ઉખેડીને નાશ કરો અને પીળા ચીકણા ટ્રેપથી સફેદ માખી કાબૂમાં રાખો; આવતી સીઝનમાં ઝીણી જાળી નીચે ધરુ તૈયાર કરો.
texts.hi: मुड़े हुए पौधे जल्दी उखाड़कर नष्ट करें और पीले चिपचिपे जालों से सफेद मक्खी काबू करें। अगले मौसम में पौध महीन जाली के नीचे तैयार करें।
texts.kn: ಸುರುಳಿಯಾದ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಬೇಗ ಕಿತ್ತು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ, ಹಳದಿ ಅಂಟು ಬಲೆಗಳಿಂದ ಬಿಳಿನೊಣ ಹತೋಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂಗಾಮಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಸಿಗಳನ್ನು ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ಬಲೆಯ ಅಡಿ ಬೆಳೆಸಿ.
texts.ml: ചുരുണ്ട ചെടികൾ നേരത്തെ പിഴുതെടുത്ത് നശിപ്പിക്കുക, മഞ്ഞ ഒട്ടും കെണികൾ കൊണ്ട് വെള്ളീച്ചയെ നിയന്ത്രിക്കുക; അടുത്ത സീസണിൽ നേർത്ത വലയ്ക്കുള്ളിൽ തൈകൾ വളർത്തുക.
texts.mr: मुरडलेली झाडे लवकर उपटून नष्ट करा आणि पिवळ्या चिकट सापळ्यांनी पांढऱ्या माशीवर नियंत्रण ठेवा. पुढच्या हंगामात रोपे बारीक जाळीखाली वाढवा.
texts.or: କୁଞ୍ଚିତ ଗଛ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଉପାଡ଼ି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ହଳଦିଆ ଆଠାଯୁକ୍ତ ଫାନ୍ଦରେ ଧଳା ମାଛି ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଆସନ୍ତା ମରସୁମରେ ସରୁ ଜାଲି ତଳେ ଚାରା ବଢ଼ାନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਮੁੜੇ ਹੋਏ ਬੂਟੇ ਛੇਤੀ ਪੁੱਟ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਪੀਲੇ ਚਿਪਚਿਪੇ ਟ੍ਰੈਪਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਚਿੱਟੀ ਮੱਖੀ ਨੂੰ ਕਾਬੂ ਕਰੋ; ਅਗਲੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਾਰੀਕ ਜਾਲੀ ਹੇਠ ਪਨੀਰੀ ਤਿਆਰ ਕਰੋ।
texts.ta: சுருண்ட செடிகளை ஆரம்பத்திலேயே பிடுங்கி அழியுங்கள், மஞ்சள் ஒட்டும் பொறிகளால் வெள்ளை ஈக்களைக் கட்டுப்படுத்துங்கள். அடுத்த பருவத்தில் நாற்றுகளை மெல்லிய வலைக்குள் வளர்த்தெடுங்கள்.
texts.te: ముడుచుకున్న మొక్కలను ముందుగానే పీకి నాశనం చేయండి. పసుపు జిగురు అట్టలతో తెల్లదోమలను అదుపు చేయండి. వచ్చే సీజన్‌లో నారును సన్నని వల కింద పెంచండి.

symptoms: You will see many small grey spots on the leaves.
These spots are round and have a dark border.
The spots start on the lower leaves and move up the plant.
The spots can join together and cause the leaves to wither.
The plant may lose all its affected leaves.
The disease can sometimes attack stems and flowers.

discriminators.question: Are there many small round spots with a grey centre and dark edge, without rings inside?
Are the spots small and brown with a yellow ring around them, and do green fruits have raised scabby spots?

diseases.favourable_conditions: High humidity or dew at 25 degrees Celsius and moist weather with rain showers favor this disease.
prevention: Ask your local agricultural office for resistant or tolerant plant varieties.
Use seeds that have been treated to prevent infection.
Keep your fields clean to stop the disease from spreading.
practices: Remove and destroy any plant parts that look sick.
Monitor your plants regularly for signs of the disease.
Follow good field hygiene practices to stop the spread.

texts.bn: নিচের দাগ পড়া পাতা তুলে নষ্ট করুন এবং জমি পরিষ্কার রাখুন।
texts.gu: નીચેના ડાઘવાળા પાન કાઢીને નાશ કરો અને ખેતર સ્વચ્છ રાખો.
texts.hi: नीचे की धब्बेदार पत्तियां हटाकर नष्ट करें और खेत साफ रखें।
texts.kn: ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಚುಕ್ಕೆ ಬಿದ್ದ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ, ಹೊಲವನ್ನು ಸ್ವಚ್ಛವಾಗಿಡಿ.
texts.ml: താഴത്തെ പുള്ളിയുള്ള ഇലകൾ നീക്കി നശിപ്പിക്കുക, വയൽ വൃത്തിയായി സൂക്ഷിക്കുക.
texts.mr: खालची ठिपके पडलेली पाने काढून नष्ट करा आणि शेत स्वच्छ ठेवा.
texts.or: ତଳର ଦାଗ ଥିବା ପତ୍ର ବାହାର କରି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଜମି ସଫା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਹੇਠਲੇ ਧੱਬਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਪੱਤੇ ਕੱਢ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਖੇਤ ਸਾਫ਼ ਰੱਖੋ।
texts.ta: கீழ் உள்ள புள்ளி விழுந்த இலைகளை அகற்றி அழியுங்கள், வயலைச் சுத்தமாக வைத்திருங்கள்.
texts.te: కింది మచ్చలున్న ఆకులను తీసి నాశనం చేయండి. పొలాన్ని శుభ్రంగా ఉంచండి.

symptoms: Small brown spots with a yellow ring appear on the leaves.
Older leaves may drop off the plant.
Small water-soaked spots appear on green fruit.
These spots grow into raised, rough, and scabby sores.
The centers of the sores turn light brown and sink in.

discriminators.question: Are the spots small and brown with a yellow ring around them, and do green fruits have raised scabby spots?

diseases.favourable_conditions: Moist weather, heavy rainstorms, high humidity, or persistent dew help the disease spread.
prevention: Always use seeds and seedlings that are free of disease.
Rotate your tomato crop with plants that do not catch this disease.
Avoid planting in areas where you grew tomatoes last year to keep away from old plant trash.
practices: Remove and destroy any plant parts that show signs of the disease.
Clear away old plant debris from the field to stop the spread.
Monitor your plants closely for new spots.

first_action.text: Remove and destroy spotted leaves and fruits; next season, use disease-free seed and seedlings and rotate the crop.

texts.bn: দাগ পড়া পাতা ও ফল তুলে নষ্ট করুন। পরের মরসুমে রোগমুক্ত বীজ ও চারা ব্যবহার করুন এবং ফসলের আবর্তন করুন।
texts.gu: ડાઘવાળા પાન અને ફળ કાઢીને નાશ કરો; આવતી સીઝનમાં રોગમુક્ત બીજ અને ધરુ વાપરો અને પાકની ફેરબદલી કરો.
texts.hi: धब्बेदार पत्तियां और फल हटाकर नष्ट करें। अगले मौसम में रोग-मुक्त बीज और पौध लें और फसल चक्र अपनाएं।
texts.kn: ಚುಕ್ಕೆ ಬಿದ್ದ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಯಿಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂಗಾಮಿನಲ್ಲಿ ರೋಗರಹಿತ ಬೀಜ ಮತ್ತು ಸಸಿ ಬಳಸಿ, ಬೆಳೆ ಸರದಿ ಮಾಡಿ.
texts.ml: പുള്ളിയുള്ള ഇലകളും കായ്കളും നീക്കി നശിപ്പിക്കുക; അടുത്ത സീസണിൽ രോഗമില്ലാത്ത വിത്തും തൈകളും ഉപയോഗിക്കുക, വിള മാറ്റി കൃഷി ചെയ്യുക.
texts.mr: ठिपके पडलेली पाने आणि फळे काढून नष्ट करा. पुढच्या हंगामात रोगमुक्त बियाणे आणि रोपे वापरा आणि पीक फेरपालट करा.
texts.or: ଦାଗ ଥିବା ପତ୍ର ଓ ଫଳ ବାହାର କରି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଆସନ୍ତା ମରସୁମରେ ରୋଗମୁକ୍ତ ବିହନ ଓ ଚାରା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଫସଲ ଘୂର୍ଣ୍ଣନ କରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਧੱਬਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਪੱਤੇ ਅਤੇ ਫਲ ਕੱਢ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ; ਅਗਲੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਿਮਾਰੀ ਰਹਿਤ ਬੀਜ ਤੇ ਪਨੀਰੀ ਵਰਤੋ ਅਤੇ ਫ਼ਸਲ ਦਾ ਫੇਰ-ਬਦਲ ਕਰੋ।
texts.ta: புள்ளி விழுந்த இலைகளையும் பழங்களையும் அகற்றி அழியுங்கள். அடுத்த பருவத்தில் நோயற்ற விதை, நாற்றுகளைப் பயன்படுத்தி, பயிர் சுழற்சி செய்யுங்கள்.
texts.te: మచ్చలున్న ఆకులను, కాయలను తీసి నాశనం చేయండి. వచ్చే సీజన్‌లో తెగులు లేని విత్తనం, నారు వాడండి, పంట మార్పిడి చేయండి.

symptoms: Young caterpillars eat the tender leaves of the plant.
Older caterpillars bore round holes into the fruit.
The caterpillar pushes part of its body inside the fruit to eat the inside.
You may see damaged fruits and caterpillars on the plants.
prevention: Plant American tall marigold and tomato seedlings together in a 1 to 16 row ratio.
Set up pheromone traps to catch the moths.
Use tomato nursery as a trap crop to attract egg-laying females.
practices: Regularly check your plants for damaged fruits and caterpillars.
Pick off and destroy any infected fruits and large caterpillars you find.
Install pheromone traps in the field and record the number of moths caught.
Remove and destroy trapped moths after each count.

first_action.text: Count first: act at 10% fruit damage. Pick and destroy bored fruits and big caterpillars, and set up pheromone traps.

texts.bn: আগে গুনে দেখুন: 10% ফল নষ্ট হলে ব্যবস্থা নিন। ফুটো হওয়া ফল ও বড় পোকা তুলে নষ্ট করুন এবং ফেরোমন ফাঁদ লাগান।
texts.gu: પહેલા ગણતરી કરો: 10% ફળને નુકસાન હોય તો પગલાં લો. કાણાવાળા ફળ અને મોટી ઈયળ વીણીને નાશ કરો અને ફેરોમોન ટ્રેપ ગોઠવો.
texts.hi: पहले गिनती करें: 10% फल खराब हों तब उपाय करें। छेद वाले फल और बड़ी इल्लियां चुनकर नष्ट करें और फेरोमोन ट्रैप लगाएं।
texts.kn: ಮೊದಲು ಎಣಿಸಿ: 10% ಕಾಯಿ ಹಾನಿಯಾದರೆ ಕ್ರಮ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಿ. ರಂಧ್ರ ಬಿದ್ದ ಕಾಯಿಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಹುಳುಗಳನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ, ಫೆರೋಮೋನ್ ಬಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹಾಕಿ.
texts.ml: ആദ്യം എണ്ണിനോക്കുക: 10% കായ്കൾക്ക് കേടുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ നടപടി എടുക്കുക. തുളച്ച കായ്കളും വലിയ പുഴുക്കളും പെറുക്കി നശിപ്പിക്കുക, ഫെറോമോൺ കെണികൾ വയ്ക്കുക.
texts.mr: आधी मोजणी करा: 10% फळे खराब असतील तर उपाय करा. छिद्र पडलेली फळे आणि मोठ्या अळ्या वेचून नष्ट करा आणि फेरोमोन सापळे लावा.
texts.or: ପ୍ରଥମେ ଗଣନା କରନ୍ତୁ: 10% ଫଳ ନଷ୍ଟ ହେଲେ ପ୍ରତିକାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ଛିଦ୍ର ହୋଇଥିବା ଫଳ ଓ ବଡ଼ ପୋକ ତୋଳି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଫେରୋମୋନ୍ ଫାନ୍ଦ ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਕਰੋ: 10% ਫਲ ਖਰਾਬ ਹੋਣ ਤਾਂ ਇਲਾਜ ਕਰੋ। ਛੇਕ ਵਾਲੇ ਫਲ ਅਤੇ ਵੱਡੀਆਂ ਸੁੰਡੀਆਂ ਚੁਗ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਫੇਰੋਮੋਨ ਟ੍ਰੈਪ ਲਾਓ।
texts.ta: முதலில் எண்ணுங்கள்: 10% பழங்கள் சேதமானால் நடவடிக்கை எடுங்கள். துளையிட்ட பழங்களையும் பெரிய புழுக்களையும் பறித்து அழியுங்கள், இனக்கவர்ச்சிப் பொறிகளை வையுங்கள்.
texts.te: ముందు లెక్కపెట్టండి: 10% కాయలు దెబ్బతింటే చర్య తీసుకోండి. తొలిచిన కాయలను, పెద్ద పురుగులను (లార్వా) ఏరి నాశనం చేయండి. లింగాకర్షక బుట్టలు పెట్టండి.

etl.text: 10% fruit damage.

symptoms: Leaves are evenly green for the variety, with no spots, streaks, rings or powdery coating.
Leaf edges and tips are not curling, yellowing, drying or burnt.
There are no insects, eggs, webbing, holes or bore marks on the leaves, stems or fruits.
prevention: Choose a variety that resists or tolerates the main pests and diseases, and use healthy seed or planting material.
Treat seed or planting material before sowing, preferably with a bio-pesticide.
Keep proper spacing, give organic manure and fertiliser by soil test, and avoid too much nitrogen, which makes the crop soft and easy for pests and diseases to attack.
Water the crop properly and rotate crops from season to season.
practices: Walk through the field at least once a week and look at the soil, water, plants, pests and the friendly insects that eat pests.
Look after the friendly insects and spiders by avoiding broad-spectrum chemical sprays.
Act early when you see trouble, for example by collecting egg masses or removing infested plants.

symptoms: You will see young shoots wilting and drying up.
Flower buds may fall off the plant.
Small holes appear on shoots and fruits.
The holes are often plugged with insect waste.
Inside the fruit, the insect creates tunnels filled with waste.
prevention: Do not grow brinjal in the same field year after year.
Choose varieties that have long and narrow fruits.
Install pheromone traps to catch the moths.
practices: Regularly check your field for damaged fruits and shoots.
Cut off and destroy any shoots that have holes.
Pick and destroy all damaged fruits.
Count the number of moths caught in traps every week.
Remove and destroy trapped moths after you count them.

first_action.text: Cut off and destroy wilted shoots and bored fruits every week, and set up pheromone traps.

texts.bn: প্রতি সপ্তাহে ঢলে পড়া ডগা ও ফুটো হওয়া ফল কেটে নষ্ট করুন এবং ফেরোমন ফাঁদ লাগান।
texts.gu: દર અઠવાડિયે કરમાયેલી ડૂંખ અને કાણાવાળા ફળ કાપીને નાશ કરો અને ફેરોમોન ટ્રેપ ગોઠવો.
texts.hi: हर हफ्ते मुरझाई कलियां और छेद वाले फल काटकर नष्ट करें और फेरोमोन ट्रैप लगाएं।
texts.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ವಾರ ಬಾಡಿದ ಕುಡಿಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ರಂಧ್ರ ಬಿದ್ದ ಕಾಯಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿ ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ, ಫೆರೋಮೋನ್ ಬಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹಾಕಿ.
texts.ml: എല്ലാ ആഴ്ചയും വാടിയ തണ്ടുകളും തുളച്ച കായ്കളും വെട്ടി നശിപ്പിക്കുക, ഫെറോമോൺ കെണികൾ വയ്ക്കുക.
texts.mr: दर आठवड्याला वाळलेले शेंडे आणि छिद्र पडलेली फळे कापून नष्ट करा आणि फेरोमोन सापळे लावा.
texts.or: ପ୍ରତି ସପ୍ତାହ ଶୁଖିଥିବା ଡଙ୍ଗା ଓ ଛିଦ୍ର ହୋଇଥିବା ଫଳ କାଟି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଫେରୋମୋନ୍ ଫାନ୍ଦ ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਹਰ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਮੁਰਝਾਈਆਂ ਗੋਭਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਛੇਕ ਵਾਲੇ ਫਲ ਕੱਟ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਫੇਰੋਮੋਨ ਟ੍ਰੈਪ ਲਾਓ।
texts.ta: ஒவ்வொரு வாரமும் வாடிய தண்டுகளையும் துளையிட்ட காய்களையும் வெட்டி அழியுங்கள், இனக்கவர்ச்சிப் பொறிகளை வையுங்கள்.
texts.te: వాడిపోయిన కొమ్మ చివర్లను, తొలిచిన కాయలను ప్రతి వారం కోసి నాశనం చేయండి. లింగాకర్షక బుట్టలు పెట్టండి.

symptoms: New leaves grow much smaller than normal.
Leaf stalks become very short, making leaves look like they are stuck to the stem.
The plant looks bushy because many small buds grow together.
Flowers may turn into green leafy structures instead of normal blooms.
Fruits are rare, and if they grow, they stay hard and do not ripen properly.
prevention: Remove and destroy any plants that show signs of the disease early on.
Clear out weeds from the Solanaceae family that can carry the disease.
Choose plant varieties that are known to be tolerant to this disease.
practices: Regularly check your field for plants showing signs of the disease.
Pull out and destroy any infected plants immediately to stop the spread.
Control the leaf hopper insects that carry the disease to healthy plants.

first_action.text: Pull out and destroy plants with little leaves at once; the disease is spread by leafhoppers.

texts.bn: ছোট পাতা রোগের গাছ সঙ্গে সঙ্গে তুলে নষ্ট করুন। এই রোগ জ্যাসিড পোকা দিয়ে ছড়ায়।
texts.gu: નાના પાનવાળા છોડ તરત ઉખેડીને નાશ કરો; આ રોગ તડતડિયાથી ફેલાય છે.
texts.hi: छोटी पत्ती वाले पौधे तुरंत उखाड़कर नष्ट करें। यह रोग हरे तेले से फैलता है।
texts.kn: ಸಣ್ಣ ಎಲೆ ರೋಗ ಇರುವ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ತಕ್ಷಣ ಕಿತ್ತು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ. ಈ ರೋಗ ಜಿಗಿ ಹುಳುಗಳಿಂದ ಹರಡುತ್ತದೆ.
texts.ml: ചെറിയ ഇലകളുള്ള ചെടികൾ ഉടൻ പിഴുതെടുത്ത് നശിപ്പിക്കുക; ഈ രോഗം ഇലച്ചാടികൾ വഴിയാണ് പടരുന്നത്.
texts.mr: लहान पानांची झाडे लगेच उपटून नष्ट करा. हा रोग तुडतुड्यांमुळे पसरतो.
texts.or: ଛୋଟ ପତ୍ର ଥିବା ଗଛ ତୁରନ୍ତ ଉପାଡ଼ି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଏହି ରୋଗ ଜାସିଡ୍ ପୋକ ଦ୍ୱାରା ବ୍ୟାପେ।
texts.pa: ਛੋਟੇ ਪੱਤਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਬੂਟੇ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਪੁੱਟ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ; ਇਹ ਬਿਮਾਰੀ ਹਰੇ ਤੇਲੇ ਨਾਲ ਫੈਲਦੀ ਹੈ।
texts.ta: சிறுகுட்டை இலை உள்ள செடிகளை உடனே பிடுங்கி அழியுங்கள். இந்த நோய் தத்துப்பூச்சிகளால் பரவுகிறது.
texts.te: చిన్న ఆకులు వచ్చిన మొక్కలను వెంటనే పీకి నాశనం చేయండి. ఈ తెగులును పచ్చదోమలు వ్యాపింపజేస్తాయి.

symptoms: Young seedlings may topple over and die because the stem is damaged near the soil.
Leaves show irregular brown or grayish spots and may turn yellow and fall off.
Stems develop dark brown sunken spots that can cause the plant to fall over.
Fruits show small pale sunken spots that grow to cover the whole fruit.
Infected fruits eventually turn into a soft watery mass or become black and mummified.
diseases.favourable_conditions: The disease thrives in temperatures around 29 degrees Celsius.
prevention: Always get your seeds from healthy fruits.
Treat seeds with hot water at 50 degrees Celsius for 30 minutes before planting.
Rotate brinjal with other crops like paddy or gingelly instead of planting it in the same spot every year.
Plough your fields deeply during the summer to reduce the disease in the soil.
Use resistant varieties of brinjal.
practices: Remove and destroy all parts of the plant that show signs of the disease.
Clear away all old plant debris from the field to stop the spread.
Monitor your plants regularly for any signs of spots or rot.

texts.bn: দাগ পড়া ফল ও পাতা তুলে নষ্ট করুন। পরের ফসলের জন্য সুস্থ ফল থেকে বীজ রাখুন এবং গরম জলে শোধন করুন।
texts.gu: ડાઘવાળા ફળ અને પાન કાઢીને નાશ કરો; આગામી પાક માટે તંદુરસ્ત ફળમાંથી બીજ રાખો અને ગરમ પાણીથી પ્રક્રિયા કરો.
texts.hi: धब्बेदार फल और पत्तियां हटाकर नष्ट करें। अगली फसल के लिए स्वस्थ फलों से बीज रखें और उसे गर्म पानी से उपचारित करें।
texts.kn: ಚುಕ್ಕೆ ಬಿದ್ದ ಕಾಯಿ ಮತ್ತು ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಬೆಳೆಗೆ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಕಾಯಿಗಳಿಂದ ಬೀಜ ಉಳಿಸಿ ಬಿಸಿ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಪಚರಿಸಿ.
texts.ml: പുള്ളിയുള്ള കായ്കളും ഇലകളും നീക്കി നശിപ്പിക്കുക; അടുത്ത വിളയ്ക്ക് ആരോഗ്യമുള്ള കായ്കളിൽ നിന്ന് വിത്ത് എടുത്ത് ചൂടുവെള്ളത്തിൽ പരിചരിക്കുക.
texts.mr: ठिपके पडलेली फळे आणि पाने काढून नष्ट करा. पुढच्या पिकासाठी निरोगी फळांपासून बियाणे राखून ठेवा आणि त्यावर गरम पाण्याची प्रक्रिया करा.
texts.or: ଦାଗ ଥିବା ଫଳ ଓ ପତ୍ର ବାହାର କରି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ; ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଫସଲ ପାଇଁ ସୁସ୍ଥ ଫଳରୁ ବିହନ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଗରମ ପାଣିରେ ଶୋଧନ କରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਧੱਬਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਫਲ ਅਤੇ ਪੱਤੇ ਕੱਢ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ; ਅਗਲੀ ਫ਼ਸਲ ਲਈ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤ ਫਲਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਬੀਜ ਰੱਖੋ ਅਤੇ ਗਰਮ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾਲ ਸੋਧੋ।
texts.ta: புள்ளி விழுந்த காய்களையும் இலைகளையும் அகற்றி அழியுங்கள். அடுத்த பயிருக்கு ஆரோக்கியமான காய்களிலிருந்து விதை எடுத்து வெந்நீரில் நேர்த்தி செய்யுங்கள்.
texts.te: మచ్చలున్న కాయలను, ఆకులను తీసి నాశనం చేయండి. వచ్చే పంటకు ఆరోగ్యంగా ఉన్న కాయల నుంచి విత్తనం తీసి, వేడి నీటితో శుద్ధి చేయండి.

symptoms: The plant suddenly wilts and dies.
Older leaves droop down first.
The whole plant turns yellow and stops growing.
The plant may wilt at noon and recover at night before finally dying.
The inside of the stem and roots turns brown.
diseases.favourable_conditions: High soil moisture and moderate soil temperatures help the disease grow.
prevention: Grow resistant varieties like Pant Samrat.
Rotate brinjal with crops like maize, soybean, wheat, rice, or cauliflower.
Use green manure crops like Brassica.
Keep the field clean and remove all old plant parts.
Control root knot nematodes in the soil.
practices: Remove and burn all affected plant parts.
Keep the field clean.
Control root knot nematodes to stop the disease from spreading.

first_action.text: Pull out and destroy wilted plants now; next season, grow a resistant variety and rotate brinjal with crops such as maize or rice.

texts.bn: ঢলে পড়া গাছ এখনই তুলে নষ্ট করুন। পরের মরসুমে প্রতিরোধী জাত লাগান এবং বেগুনের পর ভুট্টা বা ধানের মতো ফসল চাষ করুন।
texts.gu: કરમાયેલા છોડ હવે જ ઉખેડીને નાશ કરો; આવતી સીઝનમાં પ્રતિકારક જાત વાવો અને રીંગણ સાથે મકાઈ કે ડાંગર જેવા પાકની ફેરબદલી કરો.
texts.hi: मुरझाए पौधे अभी उखाड़कर नष्ट करें। अगले मौसम में प्रतिरोधी किस्म लगाएं और बैंगन के बाद मक्का या धान जैसी फसल लें।
texts.kn: ಬಾಡಿದ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಈಗಲೇ ಕಿತ್ತು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂಗಾಮಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿರೋಧಕ ತಳಿ ಬೆಳೆದು, ಬದನೆ ನಂತರ ಮೆಕ್ಕೆಜೋಳ ಅಥವಾ ಭತ್ತದಂತಹ ಬೆಳೆ ಬೆಳೆಯಿರಿ.
texts.ml: വാടിയ ചെടികൾ ഇപ്പോൾ തന്നെ പിഴുതെടുത്ത് നശിപ്പിക്കുക; അടുത്ത സീസണിൽ രോഗം ചെറുക്കുന്ന ഇനം നടുകയും വഴുതനയ്ക്ക് ശേഷം ചോളം, നെല്ല് പോലുള്ള വിളകൾ മാറ്റി കൃഷി ചെയ്യുകയും ചെയ്യുക.
texts.mr: कोमेजलेली झाडे आत्ताच उपटून नष्ट करा. पुढच्या हंगामात प्रतिकारक वाण लावा आणि वांग्यानंतर मका किंवा भात अशी पिके घ्या.
texts.or: ଶୁଖିଯାଇଥିବା ଗଛ ଏବେ ଉପାଡ଼ି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଆସନ୍ତା ମରସୁମରେ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧୀ ପ୍ରଜାତି ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ବାଇଗଣ ସହିତ ମକା ବା ଧାନ ଭଳି ଫସଲ ଘୂର୍ଣ୍ଣନ କରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਮੁਰਝਾਏ ਬੂਟੇ ਹੁਣੇ ਪੁੱਟ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ; ਅਗਲੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੋਧਕ ਕਿਸਮ ਲਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਬੈਂਗਣ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਮੱਕੀ ਜਾਂ ਝੋਨੇ ਵਰਗੀਆਂ ਫ਼ਸਲਾਂ ਦਾ ਫੇਰ-ਬਦਲ ਕਰੋ।
texts.ta: வாடிய செடிகளை இப்போதே பிடுங்கி அழியுங்கள். அடுத்த பருவத்தில் எதிர்ப்பு ரகத்தை நட்டு, கத்தரிக்குப் பின் மக்காச்சோளம் அல்லது நெல் போன்ற பயிர்களைப் பயிரிடுங்கள்.
texts.te: వాడిపోయిన మొక్కలను ఇప్పుడే పీకి నాశనం చేయండి. వచ్చే సీజన్‌లో తట్టుకునే రకం వేయండి, వంకాయతో మొక్కజొన్న లేదా వరి లాంటి పంటల పంట మార్పిడి చేయండి.

symptoms: The insects scrape the green parts from the leaf surface.
This feeding creates a pattern that looks like a ladder or a window.
These windows eventually dry up and fall out, leaving holes in the leaves.
In bad cases, the leaves become skeletonized and look like thin paper.
prevention: Pick off the insects by hand and destroy them.
Conserve natural enemies like wasps and bugs in your field.
Plant insectary plants like marigold or carrot to support natural enemies.
practices: Check your plants regularly for insects and eggs.
Collect damaged leaves that have grubs or egg masses and destroy them.
Shake the plants to knock the grubs, pupae, and adults onto the ground and destroy them.

first_action.text: Shake the plants and collect and destroy the beetles, grubs and egg masses.

texts.bn: গাছ ঝাঁকিয়ে গুবরে পোকা, কীড়া ও ডিমের গুচ্ছ সংগ্রহ করে নষ্ট করুন।
texts.gu: છોડને હલાવી ભમરા, ઈયળ અને ઇંડાના સમૂહ ભેગા કરીને નાશ કરો.
texts.hi: पौधों को हिलाकर भृंग, सुंडियां और अंडा समूह इकट्ठा करें और नष्ट करें।
texts.kn: ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಅಲುಗಾಡಿಸಿ ಜೀರುಂಡೆ, ಹುಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮೊಟ್ಟೆ ಗುಂಪುಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ.
texts.ml: ചെടികൾ കുലുക്കി വണ്ടുകളെയും പുഴുക്കളെയും മുട്ടക്കൂട്ടങ്ങളെയും ശേഖരിച്ച് നശിപ്പിക്കുക.
texts.mr: झाडे हलवून भुंगेरे, अळ्या आणि अंडीपुंज गोळा करून नष्ट करा.
texts.or: ଗଛକୁ ଝାଡ଼ି ବିଟଲ୍, ଶୁକ ପୋକ ଓ ଅଣ୍ଡା ଗୁଚ୍ଛ ସଂଗ୍ରହ କରି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਬੂਟਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਹਿਲਾ ਕੇ ਭੂੰਡੀਆਂ, ਸੁੰਡੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਆਂਡਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਝੁੰਡ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ।
texts.ta: செடிகளை உலுக்கி வண்டுகள், புழுக்கள், முட்டைக் குவியல்களைச் சேகரித்து அழியுங்கள்.
texts.te: మొక్కలను ఊపి, పెంకు పురుగులను, వాటి పిల్ల పురుగులను, గుడ్ల సముదాయాలను ఏరి నాశనం చేయండి.

symptoms: Leaves are evenly green for the variety, with no spots, streaks, rings or powdery coating.
Leaf edges and tips are not curling, yellowing, drying or burnt.
There are no insects, eggs, webbing, holes or bore marks on the leaves, stems or fruits.
prevention: Choose a variety that resists or tolerates the main pests and diseases, and use healthy seed or planting material.
Treat seed or planting material before sowing, preferably with a bio-pesticide.
Keep proper spacing, give organic manure and fertiliser by soil test, and avoid too much nitrogen, which makes the crop soft and easy for pests and diseases to attack.
Water the crop properly and rotate crops from season to season.
practices: Walk through the field at least once a week and look at the soil, water, plants, pests and the friendly insects that eat pests.
Look after the friendly insects and spiders by avoiding broad-spectrum chemical sprays.
Act early when you see trouble, for example by collecting egg masses or removing infested plants.

symptoms: The lower leaves start to turn a light yellow color, especially around the edges.
These leaves eventually turn bright yellow and dry out.
The leaves may break near the base and hang down around the stem.
The base of the stem splits open.
Inside the roots and stem, you will see red or brown streaks.

discriminators.question: Do the older leaves turn yellow from the edges and hang down around the stem, and is the inside of the stem reddish brown when cut?
Are the new leaves narrow, stiff and bunched at the top, with dark green streaks along the veins?

diseases.favourable_conditions: The disease builds up when you grow bananas in the same field over and over again.
prevention: Rotate your banana crops with paddy or sugarcane.
Plant varieties that are resistant to the wilt.
Always select healthy suckers for planting.
Make sure your field has good drainage, especially when it rains.
Do not wear footwear on your farm that has been in contact with other banana plants or soil.
practices: Remove and destroy any plant parts that are infested after you harvest.
If you find only a few infected plants, kill and chop them up.
Stew the chopped material in water at 70 degrees Celsius for 30 minutes.
Clean your machinery and tools with a sanitary solution.
Use mechanical barriers around infected plants to stop the spread.

organic_bio.text: About 60 mg of Pseudomonas fluorescens (in a capsule) can be applied in a 10 cm deep hole made in the corm.
Trichoderma viride @ 25 g for 4 times once at the time of planting in the planting pit and remaining doses at third, fifth and seventh month after planting
T.harzianum Th-10, as dried banana leaf formulation @ 10g/platn in basal + top dressing on 2,4,and 6 months after planting

texts.or: ଶୁଖିଯାଇଥିବା ଗଛ ବାହାର କରି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ; ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ରୋପଣ ପାଇଁ ସୁସ୍ଥ ଚାରା ଓ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧୀ ପ୍ରଜାତି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଧାନ ବା ଆଖୁ ସହିତ ଘୂର୍ଣ୍ଣନ କରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਮੁਰਝਾਏ ਬੂਟੇ ਕੱਢ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ; ਅਗਲੀ ਲਵਾਈ ਲਈ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤ ਪੁੰਗਰ ਅਤੇ ਰੋਧਕ ਕਿਸਮ ਵਰਤੋ ਅਤੇ ਝੋਨੇ ਜਾਂ ਗੰਨੇ ਨਾਲ ਫੇਰ-ਬਦਲ ਕਰੋ।
texts.ta: வாடிய செடிகளை அகற்றி அழியுங்கள். அடுத்த நடவுக்கு ஆரோக்கியமான கன்றுகளையும் எதிர்ப்பு ரகத்தையும் பயன்படுத்தி, நெல் அல்லது கரும்புடன் பயிர் சுழற்சி செய்யுங்கள்.
texts.te: వాడిపోయిన మొక్కలను తీసి నాశనం చేయండి. వచ్చే నాటికి ఆరోగ్యమైన పిలకలు, తట్టుకునే రకం వాడండి, వరి లేదా చెరకుతో పంట మార్పిడి చేయండి.

symptoms: You will see pale yellow or green streaks on the top of the leaves.
These streaks turn into brown spots that are shaped like an oval.
The middle of the spots turns light grey with a yellow ring around them.
The spots join together to create large patches of dry, dead leaf tissue.
The leaves dry out quickly and fall off the plant.
The fruit may stay small and thin even if the inside starts to ripen.
diseases.favourable_conditions: The disease spreads easily in poor, badly drained soils, shady areas, and during frequent irrigation.
prevention: Choose varieties that are known to be tolerant to this disease.
Do not plant your banana trees too close together.
Keep your field clean by removing weeds and grass.
Make sure your field has good drainage to stop water from sitting.
Use only healthy suckers that are free from disease for planting.
practices: Walk through your field regularly to check for early signs of the disease.
Cut off and destroy any leaves that show signs of the disease.
Remove extra suckers from the plant in a timely manner.
Keep the area around the plants free of weeds.

first_action.text: Cut off and destroy spotted leaves, and keep the field drained and free of weeds.

texts.bn: দাগ পড়া পাতা কেটে নষ্ট করুন এবং জমিতে জল নিকাশের ব্যবস্থা রাখুন ও আগাছামুক্ত রাখুন।
texts.gu: ડાઘવાળા પાન કાપીને નાશ કરો અને ખેતરમાંથી પાણીનો નિકાલ કરી નીંદણમુક્ત રાખો.
texts.hi: धब्बेदार पत्तियां काटकर नष्ट करें और खेत में पानी की निकासी रखें और खरपतवार न रहने दें।
texts.kn: ಚುಕ್ಕೆ ಬಿದ್ದ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿ ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ, ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ಬಸಿದು ಹೋಗುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಕಳೆ ಇಲ್ಲದಂತೆ ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
texts.ml: പുള്ളിയുള്ള ഇലകൾ വെട്ടി നശിപ്പിക്കുക, വയലിലെ വെള്ളം വാർത്തുകളഞ്ഞ് കളകളില്ലാതെ സൂക്ഷിക്കുക.
texts.mr: ठिपके पडलेली पाने कापून नष्ट करा आणि शेतातील पाण्याचा निचरा होऊ द्या आणि तणमुक्त ठेवा.
texts.or: ଦାଗ ଥିବା ପତ୍ର କାଟି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଜମିରୁ ପାଣି ନିଷ୍କାସନ କରି ଘାସମୁକ୍ତ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਧੱਬਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਪੱਤੇ ਕੱਟ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਖੇਤ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਪਾਣੀ ਦਾ ਨਿਕਾਸ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਨਦੀਨ ਰਹਿਤ ਰੱਖੋ।
texts.ta: புள்ளி விழுந்த இலைகளை வெட்டி அழியுங்கள், வயலில் தண்ணீர் வடிய வழி செய்து களையில்லாமல் வைத்திருங்கள்.
texts.te: మచ్చలున్న ఆకులను కోసి నాశనం చేయండి. పొలంలో నీరు నిలవకుండా, కలుపు లేకుండా చూడండి.

symptoms: Dark green streaks appear on the veins of the lower leaf and stem.
New leaves are narrow, wavy, and struggle to grow.
Leaves have yellow edges and bunch together at the top of the plant.
Plants often fail to produce fruit.
If fruit grows, the hands and fingers are twisted and distorted.
Dark brown patches may appear on young fruit.

discriminators.question: Do the older leaves turn yellow from the edges and hang down around the stem, and is the inside of the stem reddish brown when cut?
Are the new leaves narrow, stiff and bunched at the top, with dark green streaks along the veins?

prevention: Always use planting materials that are free from the virus.
Keep your field clean and free of weeds to help spot infected suckers early.
Do not grow bananas near sugarcane or cucurbit crops to prevent virus spread.
practices: Remove and destroy all infected banana plants immediately.
Chop up, dry, and bury the infected plants.
Monitor the field regularly for signs of the disease.

sources.title: TNAU Agritech Portal: Banana, Bunchy Top
NIPHM and DPPQS: AESA based IPM package, Banana

first_action.text: Uproot and destroy infected banana plants at once, chop and bury them, and plant only virus-free suckers.

texts.bn: আক্রান্ত কলাগাছ সঙ্গে সঙ্গে শিকড়সহ তুলে নষ্ট করুন, টুকরো করে মাটিতে পুঁতে দিন এবং শুধু ভাইরাসমুক্ত তেউড় লাগান।
texts.gu: રોગવાળા કેળના છોડ તરત ઉખેડીને નાશ કરો, કટકા કરી દાટી દો અને માત્ર વાયરસમુક્ત પીલા વાવો.
texts.hi: रोगी केले के पौधे तुरंत उखाड़कर नष्ट करें, उन्हें काटकर दबा दें, और केवल वायरस-मुक्त सकर लगाएं।
texts.kn: ರೋಗಪೀಡಿತ ಬಾಳೆ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ತಕ್ಷಣ ಬೇರುಸಹಿತ ಕಿತ್ತು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ, ತುಂಡರಿಸಿ ಹೂತುಹಾಕಿ, ವೈರಸ್ ಇಲ್ಲದ ಕಂದುಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ನಾಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ.
texts.ml: രോഗം ബാധിച്ച വാഴകൾ ഉടൻ പിഴുതെടുത്ത് നശിപ്പിക്കുക, കഷണങ്ങളാക്കി കുഴിച്ചിടുക, വൈറസ് ഇല്ലാത്ത കന്നുകൾ മാത്രം നടുക.
texts.mr: रोगट केळीची झाडे लगेच उपटून नष्ट करा, तुकडे करून गाडा आणि फक्त विषाणूमुक्त कंद लावा.
texts.or: ରୋଗାକ୍ରାନ୍ତ କଦଳୀ ଗଛ ତୁରନ୍ତ ଉପାଡ଼ି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଖଣ୍ଡ ଖଣ୍ଡ କରି ମାଟିରେ ପୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ କେବଳ ଭୂତାଣୁମୁକ୍ତ ଚାରା ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਬਿਮਾਰ ਕੇਲੇ ਦੇ ਬੂਟੇ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਪੁੱਟ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ, ਟੁਕੜੇ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਦੱਬ ਦਿਓ ਅਤੇ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਵਾਇਰਸ ਰਹਿਤ ਪੁੰਗਰ ਲਾਓ।
texts.ta: நோய் பாதித்த வாழைச் செடிகளை உடனே வேரோடு பிடுங்கி அழியுங்கள், துண்டாக்கி புதையுங்கள், வைரஸ் இல்லாத கன்றுகளை மட்டுமே நடுங்கள்.
texts.te: తెగులు సోకిన అరటి మొక్కలను వెంటనే పెరికి నాశనం చేయండి. ముక్కలుగా నరికి పాతిపెట్టండి. వైరస్ లేని పిలకలనే నాటండి.

symptoms: Small round black spots appear on young banana fruits.
These spots grow larger and turn brown.
The fruit skin turns black and shrivels up.
Pink spore masses cover the rotting fruit.
Black sores on the fruit stem cause the fruit to drop off.
The entire bunch can turn black and rot.
diseases.favourable_conditions: The disease spreads easily in high heat and humidity, especially if fruits have wounds or bruises.
prevention: Keep the field clean and free of weeds.
Make sure the field has good drainage.
Use proper fertilizer to keep plants healthy.
Handle fruit carefully during harvest and transport to avoid bruises.
Rotate your crops with paddy or sugarcane.
practices: Burn all infected plant parts to stop the spread.
Remove the flower bud at the end of the bunch once all hands have opened.
Harvest bunches at the right stage of maturity.
Keep the field clean and maintain good hygiene.
Store harvested bunches in a cool place.

sources.title: TNAU Agritech Portal: Banana, Anthracnose
NIPHM and DPPQS: AESA based IPM package, Banana

first_action.text: Remove the male bud once all hands have opened, and handle bunches without bruising.

texts.bn: সব হাত ফোটার পর পুরুষ মোচা কেটে ফেলুন এবং কাঁদি আঘাত না লাগিয়ে সাবধানে ধরুন।
texts.gu: બધી હથેળીઓ ખુલી જાય પછી નર કળી કાઢી નાખો, અને લૂમને ઉઝરડા ન પડે તે રીતે સંભાળો.
texts.hi: सभी फणियां खुलने के बाद नर कली हटा दें और घौद को बिना चोट पहुंचाए संभालें।
texts.kn: ಎಲ್ಲ ಹಣ್ಣಿನ ಸೀಪುಗಳು ಬಿಟ್ಟ ಮೇಲೆ ಗಂಡು ಹೂವನ್ನು ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ, ಗೊನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಗಾಯವಾಗದಂತೆ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಿ.
texts.ml: എല്ലാ പടലകളും വിരിഞ്ഞശേഷം വാഴക്കൂമ്പ് മുറിച്ചുകളയുക, കുലകൾ ഉരസലും ചതവും ഇല്ലാതെ കൈകാര്യം ചെയ്യുക.
texts.mr: सर्व फण्या उमलल्यानंतर नर फूल काढून टाका आणि घड इजा न होता हाताळा.
texts.or: ସବୁ ହାତ ଖୋଲିସାରିବା ପରେ ପୁରୁଷ କଢ଼ି କାଟିଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ କଦଳୀ ଛୁଆକୁ ଆଘାତ ନ ଲାଗିବା ଭଳି ଧରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਹੱਥੀਆਂ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਨਰ ਫੁੱਲ ਕੱਟ ਦਿਓ, ਅਤੇ ਘੌਰ ਨੂੰ ਝਰੀਟਾਂ ਨਾ ਲੱਗਣ ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਸੰਭਾਲੋ।
texts.ta: எல்லா சீப்புகளும் விரிந்த பின் ஆண் பூவை அகற்றுங்கள், குலைகளை அடிபடாமல் கையாளுங்கள்.
texts.te: గెలలో అన్ని అరటి కాయల వరుసలు (హస్తాలు) విచ్చుకున్నాక మగ పువ్వును తీసేయండి. గెలలకు దెబ్బ తగలకుండా జాగ్రత్తగా పట్టుకోండి.

symptoms: The plant may die because grubs bore into the rhizome.
You will see dark tunnels inside the rhizomes.
The unopened pipe of the plant dies.
The outer leaves start to wither.
prevention: Select healthy suckers for planting.
Do not grow bananas in the same field every time.
Keep the field clean and tidy.
Choose varieties that are less likely to get the pest like Poovan, Kadali, Kunnan, or Poomkalli.
Avoid planting susceptible varieties like Robusta, Karpooruvally, Malbhog, Champa, and Adukkar.
practices: Remove and destroy affected parts of the plant.
Trim the rhizome.
Remove pseudostems below the ground level.
Use traps to catch adult weevils.
Monitor the field regularly for signs of the pest.

NIPHM and DPPQS: AESA based IPM package, Banana

first_action.text: Remove and destroy infested plants and old pseudostems, and plant only healthy, trimmed suckers.

texts.bn: আক্রান্ত গাছ ও পুরোনো থোড় তুলে নষ্ট করুন এবং শুধু সুস্থ, ছাঁটা তেউড় লাগান।
texts.gu: ઉપદ્રવવાળા છોડ અને જૂના થડ કાઢીને નાશ કરો અને માત્ર તંદુરસ્ત, છોલેલા પીલા વાવો.
texts.hi: ग्रस्त पौधे और पुराने तने हटाकर नष्ट करें और केवल स्वस्थ, छांटे हुए सकर लगाएं।
texts.kn: ಬಾಧಿತ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾಂಡಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ, ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ, ಸಂಸ್ಕರಿಸಿದ ಕಂದುಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ನಾಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ.
texts.ml: കീടബാധയുള്ള ചെടികളും പഴയ വാഴത്തടകളും നീക്കി നശിപ്പിക്കുക, ആരോഗ്യമുള്ള, ചെത്തിയൊരുക്കിയ കന്നുകൾ മാത്രം നടുക.
texts.mr: प्रादुर्भाव झालेली झाडे आणि जुने खोड काढून नष्ट करा आणि फक्त निरोगी, साफ केलेले कंद लावा.
texts.or: ଆକ୍ରାନ୍ତ ଗଛ ଓ ପୁରୁଣା କାଣ୍ଡ ବାହାର କରି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ କେବଳ ସୁସ୍ଥ, ଛଟା ଚାରା ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਿਤ ਬੂਟੇ ਅਤੇ ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਤਣੇ ਕੱਢ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤ, ਛਿੱਲੇ ਹੋਏ ਪੁੰਗਰ ਲਾਓ।
texts.ta: தாக்கப்பட்ட செடிகளையும் பழைய தண்டுகளையும் அகற்றி அழியுங்கள், ஆரோக்கியமான, சீவிய கன்றுகளை மட்டுமே நடுங்கள்.
texts.te: ఆశించిన మొక్కలను, పాత కాండాలను తీసి నాశనం చేయండి. ఆరోగ్యంగా ఉన్న, చెక్కిన పిలకలనే నాటండి.

symptoms: Leaves are evenly green for the variety, with no spots, streaks, rings or powdery coating.
Leaf edges and tips are not curling, yellowing, drying or burnt.
There are no insects, eggs, webbing, holes or bore marks on the leaves, stems or fruits.
prevention: Choose a variety that resists or tolerates the main pests and diseases, and use healthy seed or planting material.
Treat seed or planting material before sowing, preferably with a bio-pesticide.
Keep proper spacing, give organic manure and fertiliser by soil test, and avoid too much nitrogen, which makes the crop soft and easy for pests and diseases to attack.
Water the crop properly and rotate crops from season to season.
practices: Walk through the field at least once a week and look at the soil, water, plants, pests and the friendly insects that eat pests.
Look after the friendly insects and spiders by avoiding broad-spectrum chemical sprays.
Act early when you see trouble, for example by collecting egg masses or removing infested plants.

symptoms: You will see a white powdery fungal growth on leaves, flowers, and young fruits.
Young leaves may show patches that turn purplish brown.
Infected flowers and fruits often drop off the tree before they grow.
The disease can prevent fruits from setting on the tree.

discriminators.question: Is the coating white and powdery, on the flowers, young fruits and young leaves?
Is the coating black like soot, and does it peel off the leaf when you rub it?

diseases.favourable_conditions: Rains or mists along with cooler nights during the flowering stage help the disease spread.
prevention: Use resistant or tolerant varieties where you can.
Give the orchard proper irrigation and drainage, as the AESA mango package advises for all its diseases.
Watch the trees closely at flowering time, because rain or mist with cool nights then helps the disease spread.
practices: Remove and destroy the parts of the plant that show signs of infection.
Keep a close watch on your trees to catch the disease early.

first_action.text: Watch the flower clusters closely at flowering, especially after rain or mist with cool nights.

texts.bn: ফুল আসার সময় মুকুল ভালো করে লক্ষ করুন, বিশেষ করে বৃষ্টি বা কুয়াশার পর ঠান্ডা রাতে।
texts.gu: ફૂલ આવે ત્યારે મંજરી પર ધ્યાનથી નજર રાખો, ખાસ કરીને વરસાદ કે ધુમ્મસ પછી ઠંડી રાતોમાં.
texts.hi: फूल आने पर बौर को ध्यान से देखते रहें, खासकर बारिश या कोहरे के बाद ठंडी रातों में।
texts.kn: ಹೂ ಬಿಡುವ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೂ ಗೊಂಚಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಗಮನವಿಟ್ಟು ನೋಡಿ, ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಮಳೆ ಅಥವಾ ಮಂಜಿನ ನಂತರ ತಂಪಾದ ರಾತ್ರಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ.
texts.ml: പൂക്കുന്ന സമയത്ത് പൂങ്കുലകൾ ശ്രദ്ധയോടെ നിരീക്ഷിക്കുക, പ്രത്യേകിച്ച് മഴയ്ക്കോ മൂടൽമഞ്ഞിനോ ശേഷം തണുത്ത രാത്രികളിൽ.
texts.mr: फुलोऱ्याच्या वेळी मोहर काळजीपूर्वक पाहा, विशेषतः पाऊस किंवा धुके यानंतरच्या थंड रात्री.
texts.or: ଫୁଲ ଆସିବା ବେଳେ ମଞ୍ଜରୀ ଭଲ ଭାବେ ନଜର ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ବିଶେଷକରି ବର୍ଷା ବା କୁହୁଡ଼ି ପରେ ଥଣ୍ଡା ରାତି ହେଲେ।
texts.pa: ਫੁੱਲ ਆਉਣ ਵੇਲੇ ਬੂਰ ਦੇ ਗੁੱਛਿਆਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਲ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਰੱਖੋ, ਖ਼ਾਸ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਮੀਂਹ ਜਾਂ ਧੁੰਦ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਠੰਢੀਆਂ ਰਾਤਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ।
texts.ta: பூக்கும் நேரத்தில் பூங்கொத்துகளை கவனமாகப் பாருங்கள், குறிப்பாக மழை அல்லது பனிக்குப் பின் குளிர் இரவுகளில்.
texts.te: పూత సమయంలో పూతగుత్తులను జాగ్రత్తగా గమనించండి, ముఖ్యంగా వర్షం లేదా మంచు పడి, రాత్రులు చల్లగా ఉన్నప్పుడు.

symptoms: Small blister-like spots appear on leaves and twigs.
Young leaves wither and dry out.
Tender twigs die back and branches may dry up.
Black spots develop on flowers and fruits.
Infected fruit pulp becomes hard, cracks, and decays.
Young infected fruits shrivel and drop off the tree.
diseases.favourable_conditions: High humidity, frequent rains, and temperatures between 24 and 32 degrees Celsius help the disease grow.
prevention: Collect and burn all diseased leaves, twigs, and fruits.
Cover fruits on the tree with paper bags 15 days before harvest.
Use resistant or tolerant plant varieties.
Manage fruit flies to prevent late fruit fall and disease spread.
practices: Regularly inspect the orchard for signs of the disease.
Remove and destroy any infected plant parts.
Keep the field clean by removing dead twigs and debris where the pathogen lives.
Monitor the orchard to decide when control measures are needed.

first_action.text: Collect and destroy diseased leaves, twigs and fruits, and bag fruits 15 days before harvest.

texts.bn: আক্রান্ত পাতা, ডাল ও ফল সংগ্রহ করে নষ্ট করুন এবং ফল তোলার 15 দিন আগে ফলে ব্যাগ পরান।
texts.gu: રોગવાળા પાન, ડાળીઓ અને ફળ ભેગા કરીને નાશ કરો, અને લણણીના 15 દિવસ પહેલા ફળને થેલીથી ઢાંકો.
texts.hi: रोगी पत्तियां, टहनियां और फल इकट्ठा कर नष्ट करें और कटाई से 15 दिन पहले फलों पर थैली चढ़ाएं।
texts.kn: ರೋಗಪೀಡಿತ ಎಲೆ, ಕಡ್ಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಯಿಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ, ಕೊಯ್ಲಿಗೆ 15 ದಿನ ಮುಂಚೆ ಕಾಯಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಚೀಲ ಕಟ್ಟಿ.
texts.ml: രോഗം ബാധിച്ച ഇലകളും ചില്ലകളും കായ്കളും ശേഖരിച്ച് നശിപ്പിക്കുക, വിളവെടുപ്പിന് 15 ദിവസം മുമ്പ് കായ്കൾ കവറിട്ട് മൂടുക.
texts.mr: रोगट पाने, फांद्या आणि फळे गोळा करून नष्ट करा आणि काढणीच्या 15 दिवस आधी फळांना पिशवी बांधा.
texts.or: ରୋଗାକ୍ରାନ୍ତ ପତ୍ର, ଡାଳ ଓ ଫଳ ସଂଗ୍ରହ କରି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଅମଳର 15 ଦିନ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଫଳକୁ ଥଳିରେ ଘୋଡ଼ାନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਬਿਮਾਰ ਪੱਤੇ, ਟਹਿਣੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਫਲ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ, ਅਤੇ ਤੋੜਾਈ ਤੋਂ 15 ਦਿਨ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਫਲਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਥੈਲੀਆਂ ਨਾਲ ਢੱਕੋ।
texts.ta: நோய் பாதித்த இலைகள், கிளைகள், பழங்களைச் சேகரித்து அழியுங்கள், அறுவடைக்கு 15 நாட்களுக்கு முன் பழங்களுக்கு உறை போடுங்கள்.
texts.te: తెగులు సోకిన ఆకులు, కొమ్మలు, కాయలను ఏరి నాశనం చేయండి. కోతకు 15 రోజుల ముందు కాయలకు సంచులు తొడగండి.

diseases.pathogen: Idioscopus niveoparsus, I. clypealis, Amirtodus atkinsoni, Idioscopus clypealis Lethierry, I. nitidulus Walker, Amritodus atkinsoni Lethierry, Idioscopus niveosparsus Leth
symptoms: The bugs suck the sap from the flowers.
Flower buds and flowers fall off the tree.
You will see a sticky honey dew on lower leaves.
A black sooty mould grows on the leaves.
Some parts of the plant may curl and dry up.
Young fruits may drop from the tree.
diseases.favourable_conditions: These pests appear in February when the trees start to flower.
prevention: Do not plant trees too close together.
Keep the orchard clean by pulling weeds.
Prune dense branches in December.
practices: Put up yellow sticky traps above the tree top.
Check the traps every day.
Use light traps from 6 pm to 10 pm.

organic_bio.text: neem seed kernel powder extract 5 per cent

first_action.text: Put up yellow sticky traps, and prune dense branches so light enters the tree.

texts.bn: হলুদ আঠালো ফাঁদ লাগান এবং গাছের ভেতরে আলো ঢোকার জন্য ঘন ডাল ছেঁটে দিন।
texts.gu: પીળા ચીકણા ટ્રેપ લગાવો, અને ગીચ ડાળીઓ છાંટો જેથી ઝાડમાં પ્રકાશ આવે.
texts.hi: पीले चिपचिपे जाल लगाएं और घनी डालियों की छंटाई करें ताकि पेड़ में रोशनी जाए।
texts.kn: ಹಳದಿ ಅಂಟು ಬಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹಾಕಿ, ಮರದೊಳಗೆ ಬೆಳಕು ಹೋಗುವಂತೆ ದಟ್ಟ ಕೊಂಬೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸವರಿ.
texts.ml: മഞ്ഞ ഒട്ടും കെണികൾ വയ്ക്കുക, മരത്തിൽ വെളിച്ചം കടക്കാൻ ഇടതിങ്ങിയ ശിഖരങ്ങൾ കോതുക.
texts.mr: पिवळे चिकट सापळे लावा आणि झाडात प्रकाश जावा म्हणून दाट फांद्यांची छाटणी करा.
texts.or: ହଳଦିଆ ଆଠାଯୁକ୍ତ ଫାନ୍ଦ ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଘନ ଡାଳ ଛାଣନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ଗଛ ଭିତରକୁ ଆଲୋକ ଆସିବ।
texts.pa: ਪੀਲੇ ਚਿਪਚਿਪੇ ਟ੍ਰੈਪ ਲਾਓ, ਅਤੇ ਸੰਘਣੀਆਂ ਟਹਿਣੀਆਂ ਛਾਂਗੋ ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਰੁੱਖ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੌਸ਼ਨੀ ਆਵੇ।
texts.ta: மஞ்சள் ஒட்டும் பொறிகளை வையுங்கள், மரத்துக்குள் வெளிச்சம் போகும்படி நெருக்கமான கிளைகளை கவாத்து செய்யுங்கள்.
texts.te: పసుపు జిగురు అట్టలు పెట్టండి. చెట్టులోకి వెలుతురు వచ్చేలా దట్టమైన కొమ్మలను కత్తిరించండి.

diseases.pathogen: Bactrocera (Dacus) dorsalis, Bactrocera dorsalis, B. correcta Bezzi, B. zonata Saunders
symptoms: You will see brown rotten patches on the fruit.
Some fruits may leak fluid.
The fruit might fall from the tree early.
Small worms bore into the fruit as it ripens.
The fruit starts to rot.
diseases.favourable_conditions: The flies prefer to lay eggs in ripe fruit.
prevention: Plough the soil in November and December.
This exposes the pupae to the sun to kill them.
Keep the soil covered with plants or old crop parts.
Add compost or manure to the soil.
practices: Pick up fallen fruits and put them in a pit.
Set up pheromone traps at 4 to 5 per acre.
Change the lures every 2 to 3 weeks.
Catch and kill the adult flies.

first_action.text: Pick up every fallen fruit and bury it in a pit, and set up pheromone traps at 4 to 5 per acre.

texts.bn: পড়ে যাওয়া প্রতিটি ফল কুড়িয়ে গর্তে পুঁতে দিন এবং প্রতি একরে 4 থেকে 5টি ফেরোমন ফাঁদ লাগান।
texts.gu: પડેલા દરેક ફળ વીણીને ખાડામાં દાટી દો, અને એકર દીઠ 4 થી 5 ફેરોમોન ટ્રેપ ગોઠવો.
texts.hi: गिरे हुए हर फल को उठाकर गड्ढे में दबा दें और प्रति एकड़ 4 से 5 फेरोमोन ट्रैप लगाएं।
texts.kn: ಬಿದ್ದ ಪ್ರತಿ ಹಣ್ಣನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ ಗುಂಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೂತುಹಾಕಿ, ಎಕರೆಗೆ 4 ರಿಂದ 5 ಫೆರೋಮೋನ್ ಬಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹಾಕಿ.
texts.ml: വീണ ഓരോ പഴവും പെറുക്കി കുഴിയിൽ കുഴിച്ചിടുക, ഒരേക്കറിൽ 4 മുതൽ 5 വരെ ഫെറോമോൺ കെണികൾ വയ്ക്കുക.
texts.mr: पडलेले प्रत्येक फळ गोळा करून खड्ड्यात गाडा आणि प्रति एकर 4 ते 5 फेरोमोन सापळे लावा.
texts.or: ପଡ଼ିଥିବା ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଫଳ ଉଠାଇ ଗାତରେ ପୋତିଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଏକର ପ୍ରତି 4 ରୁ 5ଟି ଫେରୋମୋନ୍ ଫାନ୍ଦ ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਡਿੱਗਿਆ ਹਰ ਫਲ ਚੁੱਕ ਕੇ ਟੋਏ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੱਬ ਦਿਓ, ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਏਕੜ 4 ਤੋਂ 5 ਫੇਰੋਮੋਨ ਟ੍ਰੈਪ ਲਾਓ।
texts.ta: விழுந்த ஒவ்வொரு பழத்தையும் எடுத்து குழியில் புதையுங்கள், ஏக்கருக்கு 4 முதல் 5 இனக்கவர்ச்சிப் பொறிகளை வையுங்கள்.
texts.te: రాలిన కాయలన్నీ ఏరి గుంతలో పాతిపెట్టండి. లింగాకర్షక బుట్టలు ఎకరానికి 4 నుంచి 5 పెట్టండి.

symptoms: You will see a black velvety coating on the surface of the leaves.
In bad cases the entire tree looks black including the twigs and leaves.
The fungus grows on the sticky sugary liquid left behind by insects.
This black layer blocks the leaf from getting sunlight which hurts the plant.

discriminators.question: Is the coating white and powdery, on the flowers, young fruits and young leaves?
Is the coating black like soot, and does it peel off the leaf when you rub it?

diseases.favourable_conditions: High humidity and moist weather help the disease grow.
prevention: Keep your orchard clean and healthy.
Prune affected branches and destroy them right away to stop the spread.
Control insects like hoppers, aphids, and scale insects that leave sugary liquid on the plant.
practices: Manage the insects and the mould at the same time.
Prune away the parts of the tree that are covered in mould.
Burn the pruned branches to stop the disease from spreading.
Spray a starch solution on the leaves to help peel off the fungus.

first_action.text: Control the hoppers and other sucking insects that leave the sticky liquid, and prune covered branches.

texts.bn: আঠালো রস ফেলা হপার ও অন্য রস-শোষক পোকা দমন করুন এবং ঢাকা পড়া ডাল ছেঁটে দিন।
texts.gu: ચીકણો રસ છોડતા તડતડિયા અને બીજા રસ ચૂસતા જીવાતનું નિયંત્રણ કરો, અને કાળી ફૂગથી ઢંકાયેલી ડાળીઓ છાંટો.
texts.hi: चिपचिपा रस छोड़ने वाले फुदकों और दूसरे रस चूसने वाले कीड़ों को काबू करें और ढकी हुई डालियों की छंटाई करें।
texts.kn: ಅಂಟು ದ್ರವ ಬಿಡುವ ಜಿಗಿ ಹುಳುಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಇತರ ರಸ ಹೀರುವ ಕೀಟಗಳನ್ನು ಹತೋಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ, ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಕೊಂಬೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸವರಿ.
texts.ml: പശയുള്ള ദ്രാവകം വിടുന്ന ഇലച്ചാടികളെയും മറ്റ് നീരൂറ്റുന്ന കീടങ്ങളെയും നിയന്ത്രിക്കുക, കറുത്ത പൂപ്പൽ മൂടിയ ശിഖരങ്ങൾ കോതുക.
texts.mr: चिकट द्रव सोडणाऱ्या तुडतुड्यांवर आणि इतर रस शोषणाऱ्या किडींवर नियंत्रण ठेवा आणि झाकलेल्या फांद्यांची छाटणी करा.
texts.or: ଆଠାଳିଆ ତରଳ ଛାଡ଼ୁଥିବା ଫଡ଼ିଙ୍ଗ ଓ ଅନ୍ୟ ରସ ଚୁଷୁଥିବା ପୋକ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ କଳା ଢାଙ୍କିଥିବା ଡାଳ ଛାଣନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਚਿਪਚਿਪਾ ਰਸ ਛੱਡਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਤੇਲੇ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਰਸ ਚੂਸਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੀੜਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਾਬੂ ਕਰੋ, ਅਤੇ ਕਾਲੀ ਉੱਲੀ ਨਾਲ ਢੱਕੀਆਂ ਟਹਿਣੀਆਂ ਛਾਂਗੋ।
texts.ta: ஒட்டும் திரவத்தை விடும் தத்துப்பூச்சிகளையும் பிற சாறு உறிஞ்சும் பூச்சிகளையும் கட்டுப்படுத்துங்கள், மூடிய கிளைகளை கவாத்து செய்யுங்கள்.
texts.te: జిగురు ద్రవం వదిలే దోమలను, ఇతర రసం పీల్చే పురుగులను అదుపు చేయండి. మసి కమ్మిన కొమ్మలను కత్తిరించండి.

symptoms: Leaves are evenly green for the variety, with no spots, streaks, rings or powdery coating.
Leaf edges and tips are not curling, yellowing, drying or burnt.
There are no insects, eggs, webbing, holes or bore marks on the leaves, stems or fruits.
prevention: Choose a variety that resists or tolerates the main pests and diseases, and use healthy seed or planting material.
Treat seed or planting material before sowing, preferably with a bio-pesticide.
Keep proper spacing, give organic manure and fertiliser by soil test, and avoid too much nitrogen, which makes the crop soft and easy for pests and diseases to attack.
Water the crop properly and rotate crops from season to season.
practices: Walk through the field at least once a week and look at the soil, water, plants, pests and the friendly insects that eat pests.
Look after the friendly insects and spiders by avoiding broad-spectrum chemical sprays.
Act early when you see trouble, for example by collecting egg masses or removing infested plants.

symptoms: Small yellow spots appear on young leaves at first.
New leaves show a mix of yellow and green patches.
The yellow spots grow larger over time.
Some leaves may turn completely yellow.
Infected leaves can show dead brown areas.
Plants stay small, grow slowly, and have few flowers or pods.

discriminators.question: Are there bright yellow and green patches mixed on the leaves?
Are the leaves larger than normal, thick, crinkled and puckered, without yellow patches?

prevention: Use varieties that are known to be resistant or tolerant to the disease.
Always plant healthy, certified seeds that are free from weeds.
Remove and destroy any plants that act as alternate hosts for the virus.
Rotate your crops with cereals, cucurbits, or cruciferous vegetables.
Plant a barrier of four rows of sorghum, maize, or bajra around your field.
practices: Regularly monitor your field for signs of the disease.
Practice good field sanitation by removing and destroying affected plant parts.
Keep the field clean and free of weeds.
Follow general cultural practices to keep the crop healthy.
Pull out plants that show yellow patches early and destroy them, so whiteflies cannot carry the virus from them.

organic_bio.text: Yellow sticky traps at 4 to 5 per acre, 15 cm above the crop, to watch and catch the whiteflies that spread the virus
Neem oil at 5 ml per litre of water against the whitefly

first_action.text: Pull out plants with yellow patches early and destroy them, and put up yellow sticky traps for the whitefly that spreads the virus.

texts.bn: হলুদ ছোপ পড়া গাছ আগেভাগে তুলে নষ্ট করুন এবং ভাইরাস ছড়ানো সাদা মাছির জন্য হলুদ আঠালো ফাঁদ লাগান।
texts.gu: પીળા ધબ્બાવાળા છોડ વહેલા ઉખેડીને નાશ કરો, અને વાયરસ ફેલાવતી સફેદ માખી માટે પીળા ચીકણા ટ્રેપ લગાવો.
texts.hi: पीले धब्बे वाले पौधे जल्दी उखाड़कर नष्ट करें और वायरस फैलाने वाली सफेद मक्खी के लिए पीले चिपचिपे जाल लगाएं।
texts.kn: ಹಳದಿ ತೇಪೆ ಇರುವ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಬೇಗ ಕಿತ್ತು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ, ವೈರಸ್ ಹರಡುವ ಬಿಳಿನೊಣಕ್ಕೆ ಹಳದಿ ಅಂಟು ಬಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹಾಕಿ.
texts.ml: മഞ്ഞ പാടുകളുള്ള ചെടികൾ നേരത്തെ പിഴുതെടുത്ത് നശിപ്പിക്കുക, വൈറസ് പരത്തുന്ന വെള്ളീച്ചയ്ക്കായി മഞ്ഞ ഒട്ടും കെണികൾ വയ്ക്കുക.
texts.mr: पिवळे डाग असलेली झाडे लवकर उपटून नष्ट करा आणि विषाणू पसरवणाऱ्या पांढऱ्या माशीसाठी पिवळे चिकट सापळे लावा.
texts.or: ହଳଦିଆ ଦାଗ ଥିବା ଗଛ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଉପାଡ଼ି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଭୂତାଣୁ ବ୍ୟାପାଉଥିବା ଧଳା ମାଛି ପାଇଁ ହଳଦିଆ ଆଠାଯୁକ୍ତ ଫାନ୍ଦ ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਪੀਲੇ ਧੱਬਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਬੂਟੇ ਛੇਤੀ ਪੁੱਟ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ, ਅਤੇ ਵਾਇਰਸ ਫੈਲਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਚਿੱਟੀ ਮੱਖੀ ਲਈ ਪੀਲੇ ਚਿਪਚਿਪੇ ਟ੍ਰੈਪ ਲਾਓ।
texts.ta: மஞ்சள் திட்டுகள் உள்ள செடிகளை ஆரம்பத்திலேயே பிடுங்கி அழியுங்கள், வைரஸைப் பரப்பும் வெள்ளை ஈக்களுக்கு மஞ்சள் ஒட்டும் பொறிகளை வையுங்கள்.
texts.te: పసుపు మచ్చలున్న మొక్కలను ముందే పీకి నాశనం చేయండి. ఈ వైరస్‌ను వ్యాపింపజేసే తెల్లదోమ కోసం పసుపు జిగురు అట్టలు పెట్టండి.

symptoms: White powdery spots appear on leaves and green parts.
These spots grow larger and turn into circles.
The white powder eventually covers both sides of the leaves.
Leaves turn yellow and fall off early when the disease is bad.
The plant may stop growing and mature too early, which lowers your yield.
diseases.favourable_conditions: Cool weather with high humidity helps the disease grow.
prevention: Remove weeds and destroy plants that can carry the disease.
Rotate your crops with plants that do not get this disease.
practices: Check your fields often for signs of the disease.
Remove and destroy parts of the plant that look sick.
Spray recommended natural extracts as soon as you see the first signs.

Vikaspedia Telugu: మినుము

first_action.text: Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE) 5% is the first spray to try when white powder first appears.

texts.bn: সাদা গুঁড়ো প্রথম দেখা দিলে নিমবীজের শাঁসের নির্যাস (NSKE) 5% প্রথম স্প্রে হিসেবে চেষ্টা করুন।
texts.gu: સફેદ ભૂકી પહેલીવાર દેખાય ત્યારે લીંબોળીના મીંજનો અર્ક (NSKE) 5% પહેલો છંટકાવ અજમાવો.
texts.hi: जब पहली बार सफेद चूर्ण दिखे तब नीम बीज गिरी अर्क (NSKE) 5% पहला छिड़काव आजमाएं।
texts.kn: ಬಿಳಿ ಪುಡಿ ಮೊದಲು ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಾಗ ಬೇವಿನ ಬೀಜದ ಕಷಾಯ (NSKE) 5% ಮೊದಲು ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿ ನೋಡಬೇಕಾದದ್ದು.
texts.ml: വെളുത്ത പൊടി ആദ്യം കാണുമ്പോൾ വേപ്പിൻകുരു സത്ത് (NSKE) 5% ആദ്യം തളിച്ചു നോക്കുക.
texts.mr: पांढरी पावडर पहिल्यांदा दिसताच निंबोळी अर्क (NSKE) 5% ही पहिली फवारणी करून पाहा.
texts.or: ଧଳା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ପ୍ରଥମେ ଦେଖାଗଲେ ନିମ ମଞ୍ଜି ଶାସ ନିର୍ଯ୍ୟାସ (NSKE) 5% ପ୍ରଥମେ ସ୍ପ୍ରେ କରି ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਚਿੱਟਾ ਪਾਊਡਰ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਵਾਰ ਦਿਖੇ ਤਾਂ ਨਿੰਮ ਦੀ ਗਿਰੀ ਦਾ ਅਰਕ (NSKE) 5% ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਸਪਰੇਅ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਦੇਖੋ।
texts.ta: வெள்ளைப் பொடி முதலில் தோன்றும்போது வேப்பங்கொட்டை சாறு (NSKE) 5% முதலில் தெளிக்க வேண்டியது.
texts.te: పిండిలాంటి తెల్లటి బూజు పొడి మొదట కనిపించగానే, వేప గింజల కషాయం (NSKE) 5% మొదట పిచికారీ చేసి చూడండి.

symptoms: You will see many small spots on the leaves.
The spots have a pale brown center with a reddish brown border.
Similar spots can appear on the plant branches and pods.
Severe cases cause the leaves to fall off the plant.
On pods, the spots start as small water-soaked marks that grow larger.
These pod spots eventually become light brown, sunken, and rough.

discriminators.question: Are the spots flat, with a pale brown centre and a reddish brown border, and no raised bumps?
Are there raised reddish brown pustules on the underside that leave powder when rubbed?

diseases.favourable_conditions: High humidity, moist weather, and heavy rainstorms help the disease spread.
prevention: Plant your crop early as soon as the monsoon starts.
Make sure your field has good drainage to keep the soil from getting too wet.
practices: Check your fields regularly for signs of the disease.
Remove and destroy any plant parts that look sick.
Keep the field clean to stop the disease from spreading.

first_action.text: Remove and destroy spotted leaves; next season, sow early as soon as the monsoon starts.

texts.bn: দাগ পড়া পাতা তুলে নষ্ট করুন। পরের মরসুমে বর্ষা শুরু হতেই তাড়াতাড়ি বুনুন।
texts.gu: ડાઘવાળા પાન કાઢીને નાશ કરો; આવતી સીઝનમાં ચોમાસું શરૂ થતાં જ વહેલી વાવણી કરો.
texts.hi: धब्बेदार पत्तियां हटाकर नष्ट करें। अगले मौसम में मानसून शुरू होते ही जल्दी बुवाई करें।
texts.kn: ಚುಕ್ಕೆ ಬಿದ್ದ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂಗಾಮಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಂಗಾರು ಶುರುವಾದ ಕೂಡಲೇ ಬೇಗ ಬಿತ್ತಿ.
texts.ml: പുള്ളിയുള്ള ഇലകൾ നീക്കി നശിപ്പിക്കുക; അടുത്ത സീസണിൽ മഴക്കാലം തുടങ്ങിയാലുടൻ നേരത്തെ വിതയ്ക്കുക.
texts.mr: ठिपके पडलेली पाने काढून नष्ट करा. पुढच्या हंगामात मान्सून सुरू होताच लवकर पेरणी करा.
texts.or: ଦାଗ ଥିବା ପତ୍ର ବାହାର କରି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଆସନ୍ତା ମରସୁମରେ ମୌସୁମୀ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହେବା ମାତ୍ରେ ଶୀଘ୍ର ବୁଣନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਧੱਬਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਪੱਤੇ ਕੱਢ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ; ਅਗਲੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਾਨਸੂਨ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹੀ ਛੇਤੀ ਬਿਜਾਈ ਕਰੋ।
texts.ta: புள்ளி விழுந்த இலைகளை அகற்றி அழியுங்கள். அடுத்த பருவத்தில் பருவமழை தொடங்கியவுடன் சீக்கிரம் விதையுங்கள்.
texts.te: మచ్చలున్న ఆకులను తీసి నాశనం చేయండి. వచ్చే సీజన్‌లో వర్షాలు మొదలవగానే ముందుగా విత్తండి.

symptoms: Young leaves show yellowing around the side veins and near the edges.
The leaf edges curl downwards.
Some leaves look twisted.
The veins on the underside of the leaf turn reddish brown.
Plants that get sick early in the season stay small and often die from the top down.

discriminators.question: Are there bright yellow and green patches mixed on the leaves?
Are the leaves larger than normal, thick, crinkled and puckered, without yellow patches?

diseases.favourable_conditions: The disease spreads in the field mainly through infected seeds or when diseased leaves rub against healthy ones.
prevention: Use healthy seeds to prevent the disease from entering your field.
Avoid planting seeds from infected plants.
practices: Monitor your field regularly for signs of the disease.
Remove and destroy any plants that show symptoms to stop the spread.

NIPHM and DPPQS: AESA based IPM package, Black gram and green gram

first_action.text: Pull out and destroy crinkled plants; for the next crop, use seed from healthy plants only.

texts.bn: কুঁচকানো গাছ তুলে নষ্ট করুন। পরের ফসলের জন্য শুধু সুস্থ গাছের বীজ ব্যবহার করুন।
texts.gu: કોકડાઈ ગયેલા છોડ ઉખેડીને નાશ કરો; આગામી પાક માટે માત્ર તંદુરસ્ત છોડના બીજ વાપરો.
texts.hi: सिकुड़े पौधे उखाड़कर नष्ट करें। अगली फसल के लिए केवल स्वस्थ पौधों का बीज लें।
texts.kn: ಸುಕ್ಕುಗಟ್ಟಿದ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಕಿತ್ತು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಬೆಳೆಗೆ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಗಿಡಗಳ ಬೀಜ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬಳಸಿ.
texts.ml: ചുരുണ്ട ചെടികൾ പിഴുതെടുത്ത് നശിപ്പിക്കുക; അടുത്ത വിളയ്ക്ക് ആരോഗ്യമുള്ള ചെടികളിൽ നിന്നുള്ള വിത്ത് മാത്രം ഉപയോഗിക്കുക.
texts.mr: चुरगळलेली झाडे उपटून नष्ट करा. पुढच्या पिकासाठी फक्त निरोगी झाडांचे बियाणे वापरा.
texts.or: କୁଞ୍ଚିତ ଗଛ ଉପାଡ଼ି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ; ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଫସଲ ପାଇଁ କେବଳ ସୁସ୍ଥ ଗଛରୁ ବିହନ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਮੁੜੇ ਹੋਏ ਬੂਟੇ ਪੁੱਟ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ; ਅਗਲੀ ਫ਼ਸਲ ਲਈ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤ ਬੂਟਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਬੀਜ ਵਰਤੋ।
texts.ta: சுருங்கிய செடிகளைப் பிடுங்கி அழியுங்கள். அடுத்த பயிருக்கு ஆரோக்கியமான செடிகளின் விதையை மட்டுமே பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.
texts.te: ముడతలు పడిన మొక్కలను పీకి నాశనం చేయండి. వచ్చే పంటకు ఆరోగ్యమైన మొక్కల నుంచి తీసిన విత్తనం మాత్రమే వాడండి.

symptoms: The spots can also appear on branches and pods.
In bad cases, the leaves will shrivel and fall off the plant.
The underside of the leaves often shows many reddish brown pustules.

discriminators.question: Are the spots flat, with a pale brown centre and a reddish brown border, and no raised bumps?
Are there raised reddish brown pustules on the underside that leave powder when rubbed?

diseases.favourable_conditions: High humidity, cloudy weather, temperatures between 21 and 26 degrees Celsius, and nights with heavy dew help the disease spread.
prevention: Remove volunteer plants from the field to lower disease levels.
Use healthy seeds that are not carrying the fungus.
practices: Check your fields regularly for signs of the disease.
Remove and destroy any plant parts that look sick.
Keep the field clean of old plant debris where the fungus hides.

first_action.text: Remove volunteer plants and crop waste; next season, use healthy seed.

texts.bn: নিজে থেকে গজানো গাছ ও ফসলের অবশেষ তুলে ফেলুন। পরের মরসুমে সুস্থ বীজ ব্যবহার করুন।
texts.gu: જાતે ઊગેલા છોડ અને પાકનો કચરો કાઢો; આવતી સીઝનમાં તંદુરસ્ત બીજ વાપરો.
texts.hi: अपने आप उगे पौधे और फसल अवशेष हटाएं। अगले मौसम में स्वस्थ बीज लें।
texts.kn: ತಾನಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಬೆಳೆ ತ್ಯಾಜ್ಯವನ್ನು ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂಗಾಮಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಬೀಜ ಬಳಸಿ.
texts.ml: തനിയെ മുളച്ച ചെടികളും വിളയുടെ അവശിഷ്ടങ്ങളും നീക്കുക; അടുത്ത സീസണിൽ ആരോഗ്യമുള്ള വിത്ത് ഉപയോഗിക്കുക.
texts.mr: आपोआप उगवलेली झाडे आणि पिकाचे अवशेष काढा. पुढच्या हंगामात निरोगी बियाणे वापरा.
texts.or: ନିଜେ ଉଠିଥିବା ଗଛ ଓ ଫସଲ ଅବଶେଷ ବାହାର କରନ୍ତୁ; ଆସନ୍ତା ମରସୁମରେ ସୁସ୍ଥ ବିହନ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਉੱਗੇ ਬੂਟੇ ਅਤੇ ਫ਼ਸਲ ਦੀ ਰਹਿੰਦ-ਖੂੰਹਦ ਕੱਢੋ; ਅਗਲੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤ ਬੀਜ ਵਰਤੋ।
texts.ta: தானாக முளைத்த செடிகளையும் பயிர்க் கழிவுகளையும் அகற்றுங்கள். அடுத்த பருவத்தில் ஆரோக்கியமான விதையைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.
texts.te: దానంతట మొలిచిన మొక్కలను, పంట వ్యర్థాలను తీసేయండి. వచ్చే సీజన్‌లో ఆరోగ్యమైన విత్తనం వాడండి.

symptoms: You will see leaves being eaten away in the early stages.
The larva often keeps its head inside the pod while its body hangs outside.
You will see round holes on the pods.
The buds, flowers, and pods may have bore holes.
Infested flowers and pods are often webbed together.
prevention: Install pheromone traps to monitor the pest population.
Place traps at a rate of 4 to 5 per acre.
Keep traps at least 75 feet apart from each other.
Set traps one foot above the plant canopy.
practices: Check your fields weekly for the number of moths in your traps.
Remove and destroy any moths caught in the traps after you count them.
Look for natural predators like ladybird beetles in the field.
Avoid using insecticides if you see natural predators active in the crop.

first_action.text: Count first: act at 3 caterpillars per plant. Set up pheromone traps at 4 to 5 per acre.

texts.bn: আগে গুনে দেখুন: প্রতি গাছে 3টি পোকা থাকলে ব্যবস্থা নিন। প্রতি একরে 4 থেকে 5টি ফেরোমন ফাঁদ লাগান।
texts.gu: પહેલા ગણતરી કરો: છોડ દીઠ 3 ઈયળ હોય તો પગલાં લો. એકર દીઠ 4 થી 5 ફેરોમોન ટ્રેપ ગોઠવો.
texts.hi: पहले गिनती करें: प्रति पौधा 3 इल्लियां हों तब उपाय करें। प्रति एकड़ 4 से 5 फेरोमोन ट्रैप लगाएं।
texts.kn: ಮೊದಲು ಎಣಿಸಿ: ಪ್ರತಿ ಗಿಡಕ್ಕೆ 3 ಹುಳುಗಳಿದ್ದರೆ ಕ್ರಮ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಿ. ಎಕರೆಗೆ 4 ರಿಂದ 5 ಫೆರೋಮೋನ್ ಬಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹಾಕಿ.
texts.ml: ആദ്യം എണ്ണിനോക്കുക: ഒരു ചെടിയിൽ 3 പുഴുക്കൾ ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ നടപടി എടുക്കുക. ഒരേക്കറിൽ 4 മുതൽ 5 വരെ ഫെറോമോൺ കെണികൾ വയ്ക്കുക.
texts.mr: आधी मोजणी करा: प्रति झाड 3 अळ्या असतील तर उपाय करा. प्रति एकर 4 ते 5 फेरोमोन सापळे लावा.
texts.or: ପ୍ରଥମେ ଗଣନା କରନ୍ତୁ: ପ୍ରତି ଗଛରେ 3ଟି ପୋକ ଥିଲେ ପ୍ରତିକାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ଏକର ପ୍ରତି 4 ରୁ 5ଟି ଫେରୋମୋନ୍ ଫାନ୍ଦ ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਕਰੋ: ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਬੂਟਾ 3 ਸੁੰਡੀਆਂ ਹੋਣ ਤਾਂ ਇਲਾਜ ਕਰੋ। ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਏਕੜ 4 ਤੋਂ 5 ਫੇਰੋਮੋਨ ਟ੍ਰੈਪ ਲਾਓ।
texts.ta: முதலில் எண்ணுங்கள்: ஒரு செடிக்கு 3 புழுக்கள் இருந்தால் நடவடிக்கை எடுங்கள். ஏக்கருக்கு 4 முதல் 5 இனக்கவர்ச்சிப் பொறிகளை வையுங்கள்.
texts.te: ముందు లెక్కపెట్టండి: మొక్కకు 3 పురుగులు (లార్వా) ఉంటే చర్య తీసుకోండి. లింగాకర్షక బుట్టలు ఎకరానికి 4 నుంచి 5 పెట్టండి.

etl.text: 3 caterpillars per plant.

symptoms: Leaves are evenly green for the variety, with no spots, streaks, rings or powdery coating.
Leaf edges and tips are not curling, yellowing, drying or burnt.
There are no insects, eggs, webbing, holes or bore marks on the leaves, stems or fruits.
prevention: Choose a variety that resists or tolerates the main pests and diseases, and use healthy seed or planting material.
Treat seed or planting material before sowing, preferably with a bio-pesticide.
Keep proper spacing, give organic manure and fertiliser by soil test, and avoid too much nitrogen, which makes the crop soft and easy for pests and diseases to attack.
Water the crop properly and rotate crops from season to season.
practices: Walk through the field at least once a week and look at the soil, water, plants, pests and the friendly insects that eat pests.
Look after the friendly insects and spiders by avoiding broad-spectrum chemical sprays.
Act early when you see trouble, for example by collecting egg masses or removing infested plants.

symptoms: You will see small black spots on older leaves first.
These spots grow larger and show a bullseye pattern of rings in the center.
The leaf tissue around the spots often turns yellow.
Spots can also appear on stems and may wrap around the plant near the soil.
In severe cases, the disease kills much of the plant foliage.

discriminators.question: Do the brown spots have rings inside them like a target, starting on the older leaves?
Are there dark water-soaked patches that spread fast, with white growth on the underside in damp weather?

diseases.favourable_conditions: The disease likes warm weather with rain and high humidity.
prevention: Always use healthy seed tubers that are free from disease.
Choose potato varieties that are known to resist this disease.
Keep the field clean by removing and destroying all old plant parts after harvest.
practices: Check your plants regularly for signs of spots.
Remove and destroy any parts of the plant that show signs of the disease.
Keep the field clean to stop the spread of spores.
