first_action.text: Remove and destroy spotted leaves; next season, use healthy seed tubers and clear old crop waste.

texts.bn: দাগ পড়া পাতা তুলে নষ্ট করুন। পরের মরসুমে সুস্থ বীজ আলু ব্যবহার করুন এবং পুরোনো ফসলের অবশেষ পরিষ্কার করুন।
texts.gu: ડાઘવાળા પાન કાઢીને નાશ કરો; આવતી સીઝનમાં તંદુરસ્ત બીજ બટાટા વાપરો અને જૂનો પાકનો કચરો સાફ કરો.
texts.hi: धब्बेदार पत्तियां हटाकर नष्ट करें। अगले मौसम में स्वस्थ बीज कंद लें और पुराने फसल अवशेष साफ करें।
texts.kn: ಚುಕ್ಕೆ ಬಿದ್ದ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂಗಾಮಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಬೀಜ ಗೆಡ್ಡೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ, ಹಳೆಯ ಬೆಳೆ ತ್ಯಾಜ್ಯವನ್ನು ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ.
texts.ml: പുള്ളിയുള്ള ഇലകൾ നീക്കി നശിപ്പിക്കുക; അടുത്ത സീസണിൽ ആരോഗ്യമുള്ള വിത്തുരുളക്കിഴങ്ങ് ഉപയോഗിക്കുകയും പഴയ വിള അവശിഷ്ടങ്ങൾ വൃത്തിയാക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുക.
texts.mr: ठिपके पडलेली पाने काढून नष्ट करा. पुढच्या हंगामात निरोगी बियाणे कंद वापरा आणि जुने पिकाचे अवशेष साफ करा.
texts.or: ଦାଗ ଥିବା ପତ୍ର ବାହାର କରି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଆସନ୍ତା ମରସୁମରେ ସୁସ୍ଥ ବିହନ ଆଳୁ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ପୁରୁଣା ଫସଲ ଅବଶେଷ ସଫା କରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਧੱਬਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਪੱਤੇ ਕੱਢ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ; ਅਗਲੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤ ਬੀਜ ਆਲੂ ਵਰਤੋ ਅਤੇ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਫ਼ਸਲ ਦੀ ਰਹਿੰਦ-ਖੂੰਹਦ ਸਾਫ਼ ਕਰੋ।
texts.ta: புள்ளி விழுந்த இலைகளை அகற்றி அழியுங்கள். அடுத்த பருவத்தில் ஆரோக்கியமான விதைக் கிழங்குகளைப் பயன்படுத்தி, பழைய பயிர்க் கழிவுகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
texts.te: మచ్చలున్న ఆకులను తీసి నాశనం చేయండి. వచ్చే సీజన్‌లో ఆరోగ్యమైన విత్తన దుంపలు వాడండి, పాత పంట వ్యర్థాలను తీసేయండి.

symptoms: Water soaked spots appear on the leaves and grow larger over time.
These spots turn purple brown and finally black.
A white growth that looks like flour develops on the underside of leaves.
Stems blacken at the nodes and may break, causing the plant to topple over.
Tubers show purplish brown spots on the surface and rusty brown rot inside.
The disease spreads very quickly and can kill the whole plant in a few days.

discriminators.question: Do the brown spots have rings inside them like a target, starting on the older leaves?
Are there dark water-soaked patches that spread fast, with white growth on the underside in damp weather?

diseases.favourable_conditions: The disease likes cool and humid weather with high humidity above 90 percent and rain.
prevention: Use resistant potato varieties for planting.
Avoid injuring tubers when you harvest them.
Do not store tubers that show signs of the disease.
Follow crop rotation to keep the soil healthy.
Avoid water logged conditions in your field.
practices: Remove and destroy any plants or tubers that look sick.
Destroy the leaves a few days before you harvest the crop.
Monitor your field regularly for signs of the disease.
Ensure your field has good drainage to avoid standing water.

Do not use the same type of fungicide again and again. For strobilurin (QoI) fungicides such as azoxystrobin used alone, use no more than 1 spray in 3, at most 3 per crop and never more than 2 in a row; switch to a fungicide of a different group in between.

avoid.text: Do not use carbendazim, or mixtures that contain it, for this disease: carbendazim does not work on water moulds (oomycetes) such as the downy mildew and late blight pathogens.

first_action.text: Remove and destroy infected plants and tubers at once, and keep water from standing in the field.

texts.bn: আক্রান্ত গাছ ও আলু সঙ্গে সঙ্গে তুলে নষ্ট করুন এবং জমিতে জল জমতে দেবেন না।
texts.gu: રોગવાળા છોડ અને બટાટા તરત કાઢીને નાશ કરો, અને ખેતરમાં પાણી ભરાવા ન દો.
texts.hi: रोगी पौधे और कंद तुरंत हटाकर नष्ट करें और खेत में पानी खड़ा न रहने दें।
texts.kn: ರೋಗಪೀಡಿತ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಗೆಡ್ಡೆಗಳನ್ನು ತಕ್ಷಣ ತೆಗೆದು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ, ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ನಿಲ್ಲದಂತೆ ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
texts.ml: രോഗം ബാധിച്ച ചെടികളും കിഴങ്ങുകളും ഉടൻ നീക്കി നശിപ്പിക്കുക, വയലിൽ വെള്ളം കെട്ടിനിൽക്കാതെ നോക്കുക.
texts.mr: रोगट झाडे आणि कंद लगेच काढून नष्ट करा आणि शेतात पाणी साचू देऊ नका.
texts.or: ରୋଗାକ୍ରାନ୍ତ ଗଛ ଓ ଆଳୁ ତୁରନ୍ତ ବାହାର କରି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଜମିରେ ପାଣି ଜମିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।
texts.pa: ਬਿਮਾਰ ਬੂਟੇ ਅਤੇ ਆਲੂ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਕੱਢ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ, ਅਤੇ ਖੇਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਣੀ ਖੜ੍ਹਾ ਨਾ ਹੋਣ ਦਿਓ।
texts.ta: நோய் பாதித்த செடிகளையும் கிழங்குகளையும் உடனே அகற்றி அழியுங்கள், வயலில் தண்ணீர் தேங்காமல் பார்த்துக்கொள்ளுங்கள்.
texts.te: తెగులు సోకిన మొక్కలను, దుంపలను వెంటనే తీసి నాశనం చేయండి. పొలంలో నీరు నిలవకుండా చూడండి.

resistance_note.text: Do not use the same type of fungicide again and again. For strobilurin (QoI) fungicides such as azoxystrobin used alone, use no more than 1 spray in 3, at most 3 per crop and never more than 2 in a row; switch to a fungicide of a different group in between.

symptoms: You may see black specks or scabs on the potato skin.
The eyes of the potato may turn dark brown when they start to sprout.
The plant may wilt because the inner tissue is damaged.
You might find sunken spots on the stem or the stem may rot.
The inside of the potato can show hard dry rot with browning.

discriminators.question: Are there black specks or crusts on the tuber skin, rather than rough corky pits?
Are there rough, corky, raised or pitted patches on the tuber skin?

diseases.favourable_conditions: The disease develops in cool, wet weather or when temperatures and moisture levels are high.
prevention: Only plant seed tubers that are free from disease.
Use crop rotation to keep the soil healthy.
Plant your tubers early in the season.
If you have well-developed tubers, plant them at a shallow depth.
practices: Leave the land fallow for two years to reduce the amount of disease in the soil.
Remove any damaged or rotten potatoes before you put them into storage.
If you wash your potatoes, make sure they are completely dry before storing them.

texts.bn: পরের রোপণের জন্য কালো দাগমুক্ত বীজ আলু ব্যবহার করুন, তাড়াতাড়ি ও অগভীরভাবে লাগান এবং জমিতে ফসলের আবর্তন করুন।
texts.gu: આગામી વાવેતર માટે કાળા ધબ્બા વગરના બીજ બટાટા વાપરો, વહેલા અને છીછરા વાવો, અને ખેતરની ફેરબદલી કરો.
texts.hi: अगली बुवाई के लिए काली पपड़ी रहित बीज कंद लें, उन्हें जल्दी और कम गहराई पर लगाएं, और खेत बदलकर फसल चक्र अपनाएं।
texts.kn: ಮುಂದಿನ ನಾಟಿಗೆ ಕಪ್ಪು ಕಜ್ಜಿ ಇಲ್ಲದ ಬೀಜ ಗೆಡ್ಡೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ, ಬೇಗ ಮತ್ತು ಆಳ ಕಡಿಮೆ ನಾಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ, ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆ ಸರದಿ ಮಾಡಿ.
texts.ml: അടുത്ത നടീലിന് കറുത്ത പാടുകളില്ലാത്ത വിത്തുരുളക്കിഴങ്ങ് ഉപയോഗിക്കുക, നേരത്തെയും ആഴം കുറച്ചും നടുക, വയൽ മാറ്റി കൃഷി ചെയ്യുക.
texts.mr: पुढच्या लागवडीसाठी काळ्या खपल्या नसलेले बियाणे कंद वापरा, ते लवकर आणि उथळ लावा आणि शेतात पीक फेरपालट करा.
texts.or: ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ରୋପଣ ପାଇଁ କଳା ଖଣ୍ଡିଆ ନଥିବା ବିହନ ଆଳୁ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଶୀଘ୍ର ଓ ଅଳ୍ପ ଗଭୀରରେ ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଜମି ଘୂର୍ଣ୍ଣନ କରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਅਗਲੀ ਲਵਾਈ ਲਈ ਕਾਲੇ ਧੱਬਿਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ ਬੀਜ ਆਲੂ ਵਰਤੋ, ਛੇਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਘੱਟ ਡੂੰਘੇ ਲਾਓ, ਅਤੇ ਖੇਤ ਦਾ ਫੇਰ-ਬਦਲ ਕਰੋ।
texts.ta: அடுத்த நடவுக்கு கருப்புப் பொருக்கு இல்லாத விதைக் கிழங்குகளைப் பயன்படுத்தி, சீக்கிரமாக ஆழம் குறைவாக நட்டு, வயலில் பயிர் சுழற்சி செய்யுங்கள்.
texts.te: వచ్చే నాటికి నల్లటి పొట్టు (black scurf) లేని విత్తన దుంపలు వాడండి. ముందుగా, లోతు తక్కువగా నాటండి. పొలం మార్చి పంట మార్పిడి చేయండి.

symptoms: The plant begins to wilt starting at the leaf tips or where stems branch out.
Leaves turn yellow at the base before the whole plant wilts and dies.
When you cut a stem, you will see a brown ring inside.
When you cut a tuber in half, you will see black or brown rings.
Squeezing a cut tuber releases a thick white fluid.
Fluid may come out of the tuber eyes and cause soil to stick to them.
diseases.favourable_conditions: High temperature, soil moisture, and low pH favour the disease.
prevention: Use only tubers that are free from the pathogen.
Rotate your potato crops with wheat.
Use resistant potato varieties.
Apply lime to the soil to change the pH level.
Keep your farming tools clean.
practices: Remove and destroy any plants that show signs of wilting.
Disinfect your cutting knife with a bleach solution.
Monitor your fields regularly for signs of the disease.
Avoid moving soil or water from infected areas to healthy ones.

first_action.text: Pull out and destroy wilted plants now; next season, plant pathogen-free tubers and rotate with wheat.

texts.bn: ঢলে পড়া গাছ এখনই তুলে নষ্ট করুন। পরের মরসুমে রোগজীবাণুমুক্ত আলু লাগান এবং গমের সঙ্গে ফসলের আবর্তন করুন।
texts.gu: કરમાયેલા છોડ હવે જ ઉખેડીને નાશ કરો; આવતી સીઝનમાં રોગમુક્ત બટાટા વાવો અને ઘઉં સાથે ફેરબદલી કરો.
texts.hi: मुरझाए पौधे अभी उखाड़कर नष्ट करें। अगले मौसम में रोगाणु-मुक्त कंद लगाएं और गेहूं के साथ फसल चक्र अपनाएं।
texts.kn: ಬಾಡಿದ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಈಗಲೇ ಕಿತ್ತು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂಗಾಮಿನಲ್ಲಿ ರೋಗಾಣು ಮುಕ್ತ ಗೆಡ್ಡೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಾಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ, ಗೋಧಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬೆಳೆ ಸರದಿ ಮಾಡಿ.
texts.ml: വാടിയ ചെടികൾ ഇപ്പോൾ തന്നെ പിഴുതെടുത്ത് നശിപ്പിക്കുക; അടുത്ത സീസണിൽ രോഗാണു ഇല്ലാത്ത കിഴങ്ങുകൾ നടുകയും ഗോതമ്പുമായി വിള മാറ്റി കൃഷി ചെയ്യുകയും ചെയ്യുക.
texts.mr: कोमेजलेली झाडे आत्ताच उपटून नष्ट करा. पुढच्या हंगामात रोगजंतूमुक्त कंद लावा आणि गव्हाची फेरपालट करा.
texts.or: ଶୁଖିଯାଇଥିବା ଗଛ ଏବେ ଉପାଡ଼ି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଆସନ୍ତା ମରସୁମରେ ରୋଗାଣୁମୁକ୍ତ ଆଳୁ ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଗହମ ସହିତ ଘୂର୍ଣ୍ଣନ କରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਮੁਰਝਾਏ ਬੂਟੇ ਹੁਣੇ ਪੁੱਟ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ; ਅਗਲੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਿਮਾਰੀ ਰਹਿਤ ਆਲੂ ਲਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਕਣਕ ਨਾਲ ਫੇਰ-ਬਦਲ ਕਰੋ।
texts.ta: வாடிய செடிகளை இப்போதே பிடுங்கி அழியுங்கள். அடுத்த பருவத்தில் நோய்க்கிருமி இல்லாத கிழங்குகளை நட்டு, கோதுமையுடன் பயிர் சுழற்சி செய்யுங்கள்.
texts.te: వాడిపోయిన మొక్కలను ఇప్పుడే పీకి నాశనం చేయండి. వచ్చే సీజన్‌లో బాక్టీరియా లేని దుంపలు నాటండి, గోధుమతో పంట మార్పిడి చేయండి.

symptoms: The skin of the potato tuber develops rough, corky spots.
You may see superficial reddish-brown spots on the surface of young tubers.
As the potato grows, these spots expand and become pitted or cracked.
Severe cases leave the potato skin covered in rough black welts.
The damaged areas may attract insects.

discriminators.question: Are there black specks or crusts on the tuber skin, rather than rough corky pits?
Are there rough, corky, raised or pitted patches on the tuber skin?

diseases.favourable_conditions: The disease is common in fields with low soil pH and is made worse by high soil moisture or too much irrigation.
prevention: Only plant seed potatoes that are free from scab.
Use a crop rotation of four to six years with alfalfa.
Add green manure to your fields before planting potatoes.
Avoid using alkaline fertilizers like calcium ammonium nitrate.
practices: Remove any damaged or rotten potatoes before placing the crop in storage.
If you wash the tubers, allow them to dry thoroughly before storing.
Keep potatoes in a dark, well-ventilated cool place for 10 to 14 days after harvest to allow cuts and bruises to heal.

texts.bn: পরের রোপণের জন্য চাকা দাগমুক্ত বীজ আলু ব্যবহার করুন, ফসলের আবর্তন করুন এবং ক্ষারীয় সার এড়িয়ে চলুন।
texts.gu: આગામી વાવેતર માટે ખસરા વગરના બીજ બટાટા વાપરો, ખેતરની ફેરબદલી કરો અને ક્ષારીય ખાતર ટાળો.
texts.hi: अगली बुवाई के लिए पपड़ी-रहित बीज आलू लें, फसल चक्र अपनाएं और क्षारीय उर्वरकों से बचें।
texts.kn: ಮುಂದಿನ ನಾಟಿಗೆ ಕಜ್ಜಿ ಇಲ್ಲದ ಬೀಜ ಆಲೂಗಡ್ಡೆ ಬಳಸಿ, ಬೆಳೆ ಸರದಿ ಮಾಡಿ, ಕ್ಷಾರೀಯ ಗೊಬ್ಬರಗಳನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿ.
texts.ml: അടുത്ത നടീലിന് ചൊറിയില്ലാത്ത വിത്തുരുളക്കിഴങ്ങ് ഉപയോഗിക്കുക, വയൽ മാറ്റി കൃഷി ചെയ്യുക, ക്ഷാരസ്വഭാവമുള്ള വളങ്ങൾ ഒഴിവാക്കുക.
texts.mr: पुढच्या लागवडीसाठी खपल्या नसलेले बियाणे बटाटे वापरा, पीक फेरपालट करा आणि अल्कधर्मी खते टाळा.
texts.or: ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ରୋପଣ ପାଇଁ ଖୁସ୍କି ରୋଗମୁକ୍ତ ବିହନ ଆଳୁ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଜମି ଘୂର୍ଣ୍ଣନ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ କ୍ଷାରୀୟ ସାର ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।
texts.pa: ਅਗਲੀ ਲਵਾਈ ਲਈ ਖਰੀਂਢ ਰਹਿਤ ਬੀਜ ਆਲੂ ਵਰਤੋ, ਖੇਤ ਦਾ ਫੇਰ-ਬਦਲ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਖਾਰੀਆਂ ਖਾਦਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਬਚੋ।
texts.ta: அடுத்த நடவுக்கு சொறி இல்லாத விதை உருளைக்கிழங்கைப் பயன்படுத்தி, பயிர் சுழற்சி செய்து, காரத்தன்மை உள்ள உரங்களைத் தவிருங்கள்.
texts.te: వచ్చే నాటికి గజ్జి (scab) లేని విత్తన బంగాళాదుంపలు వాడండి, పంట మార్పిడి చేయండి, క్షారం ఉన్న ఎరువులు వాడవద్దు.

symptoms: Leaves are evenly green for the variety, with no spots, streaks, rings or powdery coating.
Leaf edges and tips are not curling, yellowing, drying or burnt.
There are no insects, eggs, webbing, holes or bore marks on the leaves, stems or fruits.
prevention: Choose a variety that resists or tolerates the main pests and diseases, and use healthy seed or planting material.
Treat seed or planting material before sowing, preferably with a bio-pesticide.
Keep proper spacing, give organic manure and fertiliser by soil test, and avoid too much nitrogen, which makes the crop soft and easy for pests and diseases to attack.
Water the crop properly and rotate crops from season to season.
practices: Walk through the field at least once a week and look at the soil, water, plants, pests and the friendly insects that eat pests.
Look after the friendly insects and spiders by avoiding broad-spectrum chemical sprays.
Act early when you see trouble, for example by collecting egg masses or removing infested plants.

symptoms: Young and adult bugs suck sap from tender leaves, young shoots, flower clusters, young nuts and apples.
A gummy, resin-like liquid oozes from the feeding marks.
The feeding spots turn pinkish brown within a day and black in 2 to 3 days, forming black scabs.
Tender leaves crinkle, and shoots show long black streaks and may die back.
Attacked flower clusters turn black and die, young nuts drop, and badly hit trees look scorched.
photo_cues: pinkish brown to black feeding spots
reddish brown ant-like bug with black head

discriminators.question: Do you see black streaks or black spots on tender shoots and leaves too, or small reddish brown bugs, and not only on the flower clusters?

diseases.favourable_conditions: The bug thrives in temperatures between 24 and 32 degrees Celsius with relative humidity between 50 and 100 percent.
prevention: Remove other plants the bug lives on, such as neem, guava, cocoa, drumstick and cotton, from in and around the plantation.
Pull out self-sown neem seedlings in and around the cashew garden.
Do not grow cotton or other host crops between cashew trees.
When the bug breaks out, manage it together with neighbouring farmers, because one farmer alone cannot control it.
practices: Check five twigs per tree and count the young and adult bugs, mostly in the early morning when they feed.
Watch new flushes and flower clusters closely from flushing to fruit set.
Watch for the bug from new flushes through flowering to fruiting; the AESA package covers it at the flushing and flowering stage and again at fruiting.
Protective sprays against the tea mosquito bug and inflorescence blight help cashew yields, but do not spray when the trees are in full bloom.

first_action.text: Check five twigs per tree in the early morning during flushing, flowering and nut set, and remove neem and other host plants near the garden.

texts.bn: নতুন পাতা, ফুল ও ফল ধরার সময় ভোরবেলা প্রতিটি গাছের পাঁচটি ডাল পরীক্ষা করুন এবং বাগানের কাছের নিম ও অন্য আশ্রয়দাতা গাছ সরিয়ে ফেলুন।
texts.gu: નવી કૂંપળ, ફૂલ અને ફળ બેસતી વખતે વહેલી સવારે ઝાડ દીઠ પાંચ ડાળીઓ તપાસો, અને બગીચા પાસેથી લીમડા અને બીજા યજમાન છોડ કાઢી નાખો.
texts.hi: नई कोपलें, फूल और फल बनने के समय सुबह-सुबह हर पेड़ की पांच टहनियां देखें, और बाग के पास नीम तथा दूसरे आश्रय पौधे हटा दें।
texts.kn: ಚಿಗುರು, ಹೂ ಬಿಡುವ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಯಿ ಕಟ್ಟುವ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಂಜಾನೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಮರದ ಐದು ಕಡ್ಡಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ, ತೋಟದ ಸಮೀಪದ ಬೇವು ಮತ್ತು ಇತರ ಆಶ್ರಯ ಸಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ.
texts.ml: തളിർക്കുമ്പോഴും പൂക്കുമ്പോഴും അണ്ടി പിടിക്കുമ്പോഴും അതിരാവിലെ ഒരു മരത്തിലെ അഞ്ച് ചില്ലകൾ പരിശോധിക്കുക, തോട്ടത്തിനടുത്തുള്ള വേപ്പും മറ്റ് ആതിഥേയ സസ്യങ്ങളും നീക്കുക.
texts.mr: पालवी, फुलोरा आणि फळधारणेच्या काळात पहाटे प्रत्येक झाडाच्या पाच फांद्या तपासा आणि बागेजवळील कडुनिंब व इतर आश्रय देणारी झाडे काढा.
texts.or: ନୂଆ ପତ୍ର, ଫୁଲ ଓ ଫଳ ଧରିବା ବେଳେ ସକାଳୁ ପ୍ରତି ଗଛରୁ 5ଟି ଡାଳ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ବଗିଚା ପାଖରେ ନିମ ଓ ଅନ୍ୟ ଆଶ୍ରୟ ଗଛ ବାହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਨਵੀਆਂ ਕਰੂੰਬਲਾਂ, ਫੁੱਲ ਅਤੇ ਫਲ ਬਣਨ ਵੇਲੇ ਸਵੇਰੇ ਸਵੇਰੇ ਹਰ ਰੁੱਖ ਦੀਆਂ ਪੰਜ ਟਹਿਣੀਆਂ ਜਾਂਚੋ, ਅਤੇ ਬਾਗ ਕੋਲੋਂ ਨਿੰਮ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਆਸਰਾ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਬੂਟੇ ਕੱਢ ਦਿਓ।
texts.ta: தளிர், பூக்கும், காய் பிடிக்கும் காலங்களில் அதிகாலையில் ஒவ்வொரு மரத்திலும் ஐந்து கிளைகளைப் பாருங்கள், தோட்டத்தின் அருகில் உள்ள வேம்பு மற்றும் பிற விருந்தோம்பும் செடிகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
texts.te: చిగురు, పూత, కాయ కట్టే సమయంలో తెల్లవారుజామున చెట్టుకు 5 కొమ్మలను చూడండి. తోట దగ్గర ఉన్న వేప, ఇతర ఈ పురుగు ఆశ్రయించే మొక్కలను తీసేయండి.

safety_note.text: Only one product is registered for cashew in India, and it contains beta-cyfluthrin, which WHO classes as Ib (highly hazardous). If you use it, wear gloves, a face mask, a cap and full protective clothing, never spray without them, and take advice from your nearest KVK before spraying.

symptoms: You will see gum oozing out from the bark which then hardens.
The leaves turn yellow and start to fall off.
Twigs begin to dry up as the damage gets worse.
The tree eventually dies because the pest stops the flow of sap.
diseases.favourable_conditions: The pest infestation is more severe in neglected plantations and during the summer months.
prevention: Remove dead trees and trees with advanced attack at least once every 6 months.
Do not wound trunks with sickles or other tools, because wounds attract the beetle to lay eggs.
Keep the plantation clean and look closely at trees older than two years.
practices: Look for gum and powdery waste coming out of small holes at the base of the trunk.
Chisel out the damaged bark at a live hole and remove the grubs.
After removing the grubs, swab the trunk up to 1 metre high with neem oil (50 ml neem oil in 1 litre water with 0.5 ml teepol or 5 g soap).

organic_bio.text: Neem oil swab on the trunk up to 1 metre after removing grubs: 50 ml neem oil + 1 litre water + 0.5 ml teepol or 5 g soap

sources.title: NIPHM and DPPQS: AESA based IPM package, Cashew

first_action.text: Chisel out damaged bark at live holes, remove the grubs and swab the trunk with neem oil.

texts.bn: জীবন্ত ছিদ্রের কাছে নষ্ট ছাল ছেনি দিয়ে চেঁছে ফেলুন, কীড়া বের করুন এবং গুঁড়িতে নিমের তেল মাখান।
texts.gu: જીવંત કાણા પાસેથી નુકસાન પામેલી છાલ છોલી કાઢો, ઈયળ કાઢી નાખો અને થડ પર લીમડાનું તેલ લગાવો.
texts.hi: जीवित छेदों के पास की क्षतिग्रस्त छाल छेनी से निकालें, इल्लियां निकाल दें और तने पर नीम का तेल लगाएं।
texts.kn: ಜೀವಂತ ರಂಧ್ರಗಳ ಬಳಿ ಹಾನಿಯಾದ ತೊಗಟೆಯನ್ನು ಉಳಿಯಿಂದ ಕೆತ್ತಿ, ಹುಳುಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದು, ಕಾಂಡಕ್ಕೆ ಬೇವಿನ ಎಣ್ಣೆ ಹಚ್ಚಿ.
texts.ml: ജീവനുള്ള ദ്വാരങ്ങൾക്കടുത്ത് കേടായ തോൽ ഉളി കൊണ്ട് ചെത്തി നീക്കുക, പുഴുക്കളെ എടുത്തുകളയുക, തടിയിൽ വേപ്പെണ്ണ പുരട്ടുക.
texts.mr: जिवंत छिद्रांजवळील खराब साल छिन्नीने काढा, अळ्या बाहेर काढा आणि खोडावर कडुनिंबाचे तेल लावा.
texts.or: ଜୀବନ୍ତ ଛିଦ୍ର ପାଖରେ ନଷ୍ଟ ଛାଲ ଛେଦି ବାହାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ପୋକ ବାହାର କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ କାଣ୍ଡରେ ନିମ ତେଲ ବୋଳନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਜਿਉਂਦੇ ਛੇਕਾਂ ਕੋਲੋਂ ਖਰਾਬ ਛਿੱਲ ਛੈਣੀ ਨਾਲ ਕੱਢੋ, ਸੁੰਡੀਆਂ ਕੱਢ ਦਿਓ ਅਤੇ ਤਣੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਨਿੰਮ ਦਾ ਤੇਲ ਲਾਓ।
texts.ta: உயிருள்ள துளைகளில் சேதமான பட்டையை உளியால் செதுக்கி, புழுக்களை எடுத்து, தண்டில் வேப்ப எண்ணெய் தடவுங்கள்.
texts.te: పురుగు ఉన్న రంధ్రాల దగ్గర దెబ్బతిన్న బెరడును ఉలితో తొలగించండి. పురుగులను తీసేసి, చెట్టు మొదలుకు వేప నూనె పూయండి.

diseases.pathogen: Rhynchothrips raoensis Ramakrishna Ayyar, Selenothrips rubrocinctus Giard., Rhipiphorothrips cruentatus Hood, Retithrips syriacus Mayet
symptoms: Young and adult thrips live in groups on the underside of leaves and suck sap from leaves, flower clusters, apples and nuts.
Leaves turn pale brown and crinkle, with a rough upper surface.
Scabs and corky layers form on flower stalks, apples and nuts.
Flowers and young fruits drop and nuts are misshapen; in bad cases leaves fall and trees stop growing.
photo_cues: corky scab on nuts and apples
greenish yellow nymphs with red bands
diseases.favourable_conditions: Foliage thrips build up in the dry season from December to a peak in April and May, and fall in the rains; flushes after the monsoon are attacked most.
prevention: Plant Sesbania grandiflora to act as a barrier.
Do not plant chilli or onion in the field.
Sprinkle water over seedlings to stop thrips from multiplying.
practices: Set up 4 to 5 sticky traps per acre.
Use yellow or blue tins coated with grease, Vaseline, or castor oil.
Count nymphs and adults on five twigs or leaves per plant.
Use the tapping method to count thrips.

sources.title: NIPHM and DPPQS: AESA based IPM package, Cashew
WHO Recommended Classification of Pesticides by Hazard, 2019 edition (beta-cyfluthrin: class Ib)

first_action.text: Put up blue or yellow sticky traps at 4 to 5 per acre and count thrips on five twigs per tree.

texts.bn: প্রতি একরে 4 থেকে 5টি নীল বা হলুদ আঠালো ফাঁদ লাগান এবং প্রতি গাছের পাঁচটি ডালে থ্রিপস গুনুন।
texts.gu: એકર દીઠ 4 થી 5 વાદળી કે પીળા ચીકણા ટ્રેપ લગાવો અને ઝાડ દીઠ પાંચ ડાળીઓ પર થ્રિપ્સ ગણો.
texts.hi: प्रति एकड़ 4 से 5 नीले या पीले चिपचिपे जाल लगाएं और हर पेड़ की पांच टहनियों पर थ्रिप्स गिनें।
texts.kn: ಎಕರೆಗೆ 4 ರಿಂದ 5 ನೀಲಿ ಅಥವಾ ಹಳದಿ ಅಂಟು ಬಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹಾಕಿ, ಪ್ರತಿ ಮರದ ಐದು ಕಡ್ಡಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಥ್ರಿಪ್ಸ್ ಎಣಿಸಿ.
texts.ml: ഒരേക്കറിൽ 4 മുതൽ 5 വരെ നീലയോ മഞ്ഞയോ ഒട്ടും കെണികൾ വയ്ക്കുക, ഒരു മരത്തിലെ അഞ്ച് ചില്ലകളിൽ ഇലപ്പേൻ എണ്ണുക.
texts.mr: प्रति एकर 4 ते 5 निळे किंवा पिवळे चिकट सापळे लावा आणि प्रत्येक झाडाच्या पाच फांद्यांवर फुलकिडे मोजा.
texts.or: ଏକର ପ୍ରତି 4 ରୁ 5ଟି ନୀଳ ବା ହଳଦିଆ ଆଠାଯୁକ୍ତ ଫାନ୍ଦ ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରତି ଗଛର 5ଟି ଡାଳରେ ଥ୍ରିପ୍ସ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਏਕੜ 4 ਤੋਂ 5 ਨੀਲੇ ਜਾਂ ਪੀਲੇ ਚਿਪਚਿਪੇ ਟ੍ਰੈਪ ਲਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਹਰ ਰੁੱਖ ਦੀਆਂ ਪੰਜ ਟਹਿਣੀਆਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਥ੍ਰਿਪਸ ਗਿਣੋ।
texts.ta: ஏக்கருக்கு 4 முதல் 5 நீல அல்லது மஞ்சள் ஒட்டும் பொறிகளை வையுங்கள், ஒரு மரத்தின் ஐந்து கிளைகளில் இலைப்பேனை எண்ணுங்கள்.
texts.te: నీలం లేదా పసుపు జిగురు అట్టలు ఎకరానికి 4 నుంచి 5 పెట్టండి. చెట్టుకు 5 కొమ్మలపై తామర పురుగులను లెక్కపెట్టండి.

safety_note.text: Only one product is registered for cashew in India, and it contains beta-cyfluthrin, which WHO classes as Ib (highly hazardous). If you use it, wear gloves, a face mask, a cap and full protective clothing, never spray without them, and take advice from your nearest KVK before spraying.

symptoms: The fungus attacks tender leaves and twigs.
You will see reddish brown spots that look water-soaked.
Sticky resin may ooze out from the affected areas.
The spots grow larger and kill the shoots.
Tender leaves become crinkled and fruits shrivel up.
Infected flower parts turn black and the tree may eventually die.

discriminators.question: Are the spots mostly on the flower stalks, starting small and water-soaked and then turning pinkish brown and scabby?
Is there a white or pink growth or silky threads on the dying branches?

diseases.favourable_conditions: High humidity, frequent rains, and temperatures between 24 and 32 degrees Celsius help the disease grow.
prevention: Collect and burn all diseased leaves and twigs.
Ask your local agricultural office about varieties that resist this disease.
Cover fruits with paper bags 15 days before you harvest them.
practices: Regularly check your trees for signs of damage.
Cut off and destroy all affected branches and twigs.
Keep your plantation free of weeds.

sources.title: TNAU Agritech Portal: Cashew, Crop Protection
NIPHM and DPPQS: AESA based IPM package, Cashew

first_action.text: Cut off and destroy affected twigs and collect fallen diseased leaves.

texts.bn: আক্রান্ত ডাল কেটে নষ্ট করুন এবং ঝরে পড়া রোগাক্রান্ত পাতা সংগ্রহ করুন।
texts.gu: અસરગ્રસ્ત ડાળીઓ કાપીને નાશ કરો અને પડેલા રોગવાળા પાન ભેગા કરો.
texts.hi: रोगी टहनियां काटकर नष्ट करें और गिरी हुई रोगी पत्तियां इकट्ठा करें।
texts.kn: ಬಾಧಿತ ಕಡ್ಡಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿ ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ, ಬಿದ್ದ ರೋಗಪೀಡಿತ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ.
texts.ml: ബാധിച്ച ചില്ലകൾ വെട്ടി നശിപ്പിക്കുക, വീണുകിടക്കുന്ന രോഗമുള്ള ഇലകൾ ശേഖരിക്കുക.
texts.mr: बाधित फांद्या कापून नष्ट करा आणि गळून पडलेली रोगट पाने गोळा करा.
texts.or: ଆକ୍ରାନ୍ତ ଡାଳ କାଟି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ପଡ଼ିଥିବା ରୋଗାକ୍ରାନ୍ତ ପତ୍ର ସଂଗ୍ରହ କରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਿਤ ਟਹਿਣੀਆਂ ਕੱਟ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਡਿੱਗੇ ਹੋਏ ਬਿਮਾਰ ਪੱਤੇ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਕਰੋ।
texts.ta: பாதித்த கிளைகளை வெட்டி அழியுங்கள், விழுந்த நோய் இலைகளைச் சேகரியுங்கள்.
texts.te: తెగులు సోకిన కొమ్మలను కోసి నాశనం చేయండి. రాలిన తెగులు సోకిన ఆకులను ఏరండి.

symptoms: The floral branches begin to dry up.
Small water-soaked spots appear on the main and side flower stalks.
These spots turn pinkish brown and eventually become scabby.
Sticky gum may ooze out from the affected areas.
The spots grow into large patches that cause the entire flower cluster to dry.

discriminators.question: Do you see black streaks or black spots on tender shoots and leaves too, or small reddish brown bugs, and not only on the flower clusters?
Are the spots mostly on the flower stalks, starting small and water-soaked and then turning pinkish brown and scabby?

diseases.favourable_conditions: The disease is very severe when there is cloudy weather, high humidity, frequent rains, and temperatures between 24 and 32 degrees Celsius.
prevention: Avoid planting cashew in areas that get heavy rain during the flowering and fruiting time.
Do not plant cashew where temperatures stay below 20 degrees Celsius for a long time.
Consult your local agricultural office to find varieties that resist this disease.
Keep the field clean by removing and destroying crop waste.
practices: Monitor your trees closely during the monsoon season.
Remove and destroy any parts of the plant that show signs of the disease.
Manage the tea mosquito bug, as it is often the primary cause that allows the fungus to enter.

sources.title: TNAU Agritech Portal: Cashew, Crop Protection
NIPHM and DPPQS: AESA based IPM package, Cashew

first_action.text: Control the tea mosquito bug, which opens the way for this disease, and remove dried flower clusters.

texts.bn: এই রোগের পথ খুলে দেওয়া টি মসকুইটো বাগ দমন করুন এবং শুকনো ফুলের গুচ্ছ সরিয়ে ফেলুন।
texts.gu: આ રોગને રસ્તો આપતી ટી મોસ્કિટો બગનું નિયંત્રણ કરો અને સુકાયેલી મંજરી કાઢી નાખો.
texts.hi: टी मॉस्किटो बग को काबू करें, जो इस रोग का रास्ता खोलता है, और सूखे फूलों के गुच्छे हटा दें।
texts.kn: ಈ ರೋಗಕ್ಕೆ ದಾರಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಡುವ ಟೀ ಸೊಳ್ಳೆ ತಿಗಣೆಯನ್ನು ಹತೋಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ, ಒಣಗಿದ ಹೂ ಗೊಂಚಲುಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ.
texts.ml: ഈ രോഗത്തിന് വഴിതുറക്കുന്ന തേയില കൊതുക് ശല്യത്തെ (ടീ മൊസ്കിറ്റോ ബഗ്) നിയന്ത്രിക്കുക, ഉണങ്ങിയ പൂങ്കുലകൾ നീക്കുക.
texts.mr: या रोगाला वाट मोकळी करून देणाऱ्या टी मॉस्किटो ढेकणावर नियंत्रण ठेवा आणि वाळलेले फुलोरे काढा.
texts.or: ଏହି ରୋଗକୁ ବାଟ ଖୋଲୁଥିବା ଟି ମସ୍କିଟୋ ବଗ୍ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଶୁଖିଲା ମଞ୍ଜରୀ ବାହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਇਸ ਬਿਮਾਰੀ ਲਈ ਰਾਹ ਖੋਲ੍ਹਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਟੀ ਮੌਸਕੀਟੋ ਬੱਗ ਨੂੰ ਕਾਬੂ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਸੁੱਕੇ ਫੁੱਲਾਂ ਦੇ ਗੁੱਛੇ ਕੱਢ ਦਿਓ।
texts.ta: இந்த நோய்க்கு வழிவகுக்கும் தேயிலைக் கொசுப்பூச்சியைக் கட்டுப்படுத்துங்கள், உலர்ந்த பூங்கொத்துகளை அகற்றுங்கள்.
texts.te: ఈ తెగులుకు దారి చేసే టీ దోమను అదుపు చేయండి. ఎండిపోయిన పూతగుత్తులను తీసేయండి.

symptoms: You might see white or pink growth on the branches.
The tips of the shoots die and the death spreads down.
After heavy rains, you can see silky threads on the branches.
The bark can split and peel off.
Branches may turn yellow and fall off.
This can make parts of your tree look bare.

discriminators.question: Is there a white or pink growth or silky threads on the dying branches?

diseases.favourable_conditions: High humidity and moist conditions help the disease grow.
prevention: Use healthy wood for planting that has no disease.
Choose plant types that can resist the disease.
Take every care not to bring the disease into newly planted gardens.
practices: Cut off sick branches well below the sick part.
Destroy the sick branches you cut.
Clean up all dried and sick branches from the field.
Put cow dung on the cut ends of the branches.

sources.title: TNAU Agritech Portal: Cashew, Crop Protection
NIPHM and DPPQS: AESA based IPM package, Cashew

first_action.text: Cut affected branches well below the infection, destroy them and paste the cut ends with cow dung.

texts.bn: আক্রান্ত ডাল সংক্রমণের জায়গার অনেক নিচে কেটে নষ্ট করুন এবং কাটা মুখে গোবরের প্রলেপ দিন।
texts.gu: અસરગ્રસ્ત ડાળીઓ ચેપથી સારી રીતે નીચે કાપો, તેનો નાશ કરો અને કાપેલા છેડા પર છાણની પેસ્ટ લગાવો.
texts.hi: रोग वाली डालियां संक्रमण से काफी नीचे से काटें, उन्हें नष्ट करें और कटे सिरों पर गोबर का लेप लगाएं।
texts.kn: ಬಾಧಿತ ಕೊಂಬೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸೋಂಕಿನ ಜಾಗದಿಂದ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಕೆಳಗೆ ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿ ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ, ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿದ ತುದಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸೆಗಣಿ ಲೇಪಿಸಿ.
texts.ml: ബാധിച്ച ശിഖരങ്ങൾ അണുബാധയ്ക്ക് നന്നായി താഴെ വച്ച് മുറിക്കുക, നശിപ്പിക്കുക, മുറിച്ച അറ്റങ്ങളിൽ ചാണകം പുരട്ടുക.
texts.mr: बाधित फांद्या संसर्गाच्या खूप खालून कापा, नष्ट करा आणि कापलेल्या टोकांना शेणाचा लेप लावा.
texts.or: ଆକ୍ରାନ୍ତ ଡାଳକୁ ସଂକ୍ରମଣ ତଳେ ଭଲ ଭାବେ କାଟନ୍ତୁ, ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ କଟା ମୁଣ୍ଡରେ ଗୋବର ଲେପନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਿਤ ਟਹਿਣੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਲਾਗ ਤੋਂ ਚੰਗੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਕੱਟੋ, ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਕੱਟੇ ਸਿਰਿਆਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਗੋਬਰ ਦਾ ਲੇਪ ਲਾਓ।
texts.ta: பாதித்த கிளைகளை நோய் உள்ள இடத்துக்கு நன்றாகக் கீழே வெட்டி அழியுங்கள், வெட்டிய முனைகளில் மாட்டுச் சாணம் பூசுங்கள்.
texts.te: తెగులు సోకిన కొమ్మలను, సోకిన చోటుకు బాగా కింద కోసి నాశనం చేయండి. కోసిన చివర్లకు ఆవు పేడ పూయండి.

symptoms: Leaves are evenly green for the variety, with no spots, streaks, rings or powdery coating.
Leaf edges and tips are not curling, yellowing, drying or burnt.
There are no insects, eggs, webbing, holes or bore marks on the leaves, stems or fruits.
prevention: Choose a variety that resists or tolerates the main pests and diseases, and use healthy seed or planting material.
Treat seed or planting material before sowing, preferably with a bio-pesticide.
Keep proper spacing, give organic manure and fertiliser by soil test, and avoid too much nitrogen, which makes the crop soft and easy for pests and diseases to attack.
Water the crop properly and rotate crops from season to season.
practices: Walk through the field at least once a week and look at the soil, water, plants, pests and the friendly insects that eat pests.
Look after the friendly insects and spiders by avoiding broad-spectrum chemical sprays.
Act early when you see trouble, for example by collecting egg masses or removing infested plants.

sources.title: NIPHM and DPPQS: AESA based IPM package, Cashew

symptoms: The disease starts as tiny white dots on the leaves.
Yellowish areas appear on the leaf tips.
Black velvety rings form in a circle or oval shape.
Spots grow together and spread quickly across the whole leaf.
Leaves start to die from the tip down.
The plant may fail to grow a bulb.

discriminators.question: Do the spots have a purple centre with a yellow edge?
Are the spots yellow to orange and long like a spindle, with a pinkish edge rather than a purple centre?
Do the leaves turn pale green with a white cotton-like growth on them, without dark spots?

diseases.favourable_conditions: Hot and humid weather with temperatures between 21 and 30 degrees Celsius and high humidity helps the disease grow.
prevention: Select healthy bulbs for planting.
Use resistant onion varieties.
Soak seeds in hot water at 50 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes.
Rotate your crops every 2 to 3 years with plants that do not get this disease.
Make sure your field has good drainage.
practices: Check your field regularly for signs of the disease.
Ensure the field is well drained to prevent water buildup.
Use the recommended amounts of nitrogen and phosphorus fertilizers.

sources.title: TNAU Agritech Portal: Onion, Purple blotch
NIPHM and DPPQS: AESA based IPM package, Onion

first_action.text: Remove and destroy spotted leaves and keep the field drained; next season, use healthy bulbs and rotate the crop.

texts.bn: দাগ পড়া পাতা তুলে নষ্ট করুন এবং জমিতে জল নিকাশের ব্যবস্থা রাখুন। পরের মরসুমে সুস্থ কন্দ ব্যবহার করুন এবং ফসলের আবর্তন করুন।
texts.gu: ડાઘવાળા પાન કાઢીને નાશ કરો અને ખેતરનું પાણી કાઢી નાખો; આવતી સીઝનમાં તંદુરસ્ત ગાંઠ વાપરો અને પાકની ફેરબદલી કરો.
texts.hi: धब्बेदार पत्तियां हटाकर नष्ट करें और खेत में पानी की निकासी रखें। अगले मौसम में स्वस्थ कंद लें और फसल चक्र अपनाएं।
texts.kn: ಚುಕ್ಕೆ ಬಿದ್ದ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದು ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ, ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ಬಸಿದು ಹೋಗುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂಗಾಮಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಗಡ್ಡೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ, ಬೆಳೆ ಸರದಿ ಮಾಡಿ.
texts.ml: പുള്ളിയുള്ള ഇലകൾ നീക്കി നശിപ്പിക്കുക, വയലിലെ വെള്ളം വാർത്തുകളയുക; അടുത്ത സീസണിൽ ആരോഗ്യമുള്ള ഉള്ളി വിത്ത് ഉപയോഗിക്കുകയും വിള മാറ്റി കൃഷി ചെയ്യുകയും ചെയ്യുക.
texts.mr: ठिपके पडलेली पाने काढून नष्ट करा आणि शेतातील पाण्याचा निचरा होऊ द्या. पुढच्या हंगामात निरोगी कांदे वापरा आणि पीक फेरपालट करा.
texts.or: ଦାଗ ଥିବା ପତ୍ର ବାହାର କରି ନଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଜମିରୁ ପାଣି ନିଷ୍କାସନ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଆସନ୍ତା ମରସୁମରେ ସୁସ୍ଥ ପିଆଜ ଗଣ୍ଠି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଫସଲ ଘୂର୍ଣ୍ଣନ କରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਧੱਬਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਪੱਤੇ ਕੱਢ ਕੇ ਨਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਖੇਤ ਦਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਕੱਢ ਦਿਓ; ਅਗਲੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤ ਗੰਢੇ ਵਰਤੋ ਅਤੇ ਫ਼ਸਲ ਦਾ ਫੇਰ-ਬਦਲ ਕਰੋ।
texts.ta: புள்ளி விழுந்த இலைகளை அகற்றி அழியுங்கள், வயலில் தண்ணீர் வடிய வழி செய்யுங்கள். அடுத்த பருவத்தில் ஆரோக்கியமான வெங்காயங்களைப் பயன்படுத்தி பயிர் சுழற்சி செய்யுங்கள்.
texts.te: మచ్చలున్న ఆకులను తీసి నాశనం చేయండి. పొలంలో నీరు నిలవకుండా చూడండి. వచ్చే సీజన్‌లో ఆరోగ్యమైన గడ్డలు వాడండి, పంట మార్పిడి చేయండి.

symptoms: Small yellow to orange spots or streaks appear on the leaves.
These spots grow into long spindle shapes.
The spots have a pinkish border around them.
The disease can cause heavy damage to the seed stalks.

discriminators.question: Do the spots have a purple centre with a yellow edge?
Are the spots yellow to orange and long like a spindle, with a pinkish edge rather than a purple centre?

diseases.favourable_conditions: Warm weather with high humidity and long periods of wet leaves for 16 hours or more help the disease grow.
prevention: Soak onion seeds in hot water at 50 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes.
Plant resistant varieties like Welsh onion.
Rotate your crops with plants that do not get this disease.
Keep the field well drained and do not plant too close together.
practices: Collect old crop parts left in the field and take them away or bury them.
Make sure the field has good drainage.
Reduce the number of plants in the field to lower density.

sources.title: NIPHM and DPPQS: AESA based IPM package, Onion

first_action.text: Collect and remove old crop parts and keep the field drained; next season, treat seed in hot water at 50 °C for 20 minutes.

texts.bn: পুরোনো ফসলের অংশ সংগ্রহ করে সরিয়ে ফেলুন এবং জমিতে জল নিকাশের ব্যবস্থা রাখুন। পরের মরসুমে বীজ 50 °C গরম জলে 20 মিনিট শোধন করুন।
texts.gu: જૂના પાકના ભાગ ભેગા કરીને કાઢી નાખો અને ખેતરનું પાણી કાઢી નાખો; આવતી સીઝનમાં બીજને 50 °C ગરમ પાણીમાં 20 મિનિટ પ્રક્રિયા કરો.
texts.hi: पुराने फसल अवशेष इकट्ठा कर हटाएं और खेत में पानी की निकासी रखें। अगले मौसम में बीज को 50 °C गर्म पानी में 20 मिनट उपचारित करें।
texts.kn: ಹಳೆಯ ಬೆಳೆ ಭಾಗಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ, ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ಬಸಿದು ಹೋಗುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂಗಾಮಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೀಜವನ್ನು 50 °C ಬಿಸಿ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ 20 ನಿಮಿಷ ಉಪಚರಿಸಿ.
texts.ml: പഴയ വിളയുടെ ഭാഗങ്ങൾ ശേഖരിച്ച് നീക്കുക, വയലിലെ വെള്ളം വാർത്തുകളയുക; അടുത്ത സീസണിൽ വിത്ത് 50 °C ചൂടുവെള്ളത്തിൽ 20 മിനിറ്റ് പരിചരിക്കുക.
texts.mr: जुने पिकाचे भाग गोळा करून काढा आणि शेतातील पाण्याचा निचरा होऊ द्या. पुढच्या हंगामात बियाण्यावर 50 °C गरम पाण्यात 20 मिनिटे प्रक्रिया करा.
texts.or: ପୁରୁଣା ଫସଲ ଅଂଶ ସଂଗ୍ରହ କରି ବାହାର କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଜମିରୁ ପାଣି ନିଷ୍କାସନ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଆସନ୍ତା ମରସୁମରେ ବିହନକୁ 50 °C ଗରମ ପାଣିରେ 20 ମିନିଟ୍ ଶୋଧନ କରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਫ਼ਸਲ ਦੇ ਹਿੱਸੇ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਕੱਢ ਦਿਓ ਅਤੇ ਖੇਤ ਦਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਕੱਢ ਦਿਓ; ਅਗਲੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੀਜ ਨੂੰ 50 °C ਗਰਮ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿੱਚ 20 ਮਿੰਟ ਸੋਧੋ।
texts.ta: பழைய பயிர்ப் பகுதிகளைச் சேகரித்து அகற்றுங்கள், வயலில் தண்ணீர் வடிய வழி செய்யுங்கள். அடுத்த பருவத்தில் விதையை 50 °C வெந்நீரில் 20 நிமிடங்கள் நேர்த்தி செய்யுங்கள்.
texts.te: పాత పంట భాగాలను ఏరి తీసేయండి. పొలంలో నీరు నిలవకుండా చూడండి. వచ్చే సీజన్‌లో విత్తనాన్ని 50 °C వేడి నీటిలో 20 నిమిషాలు శుద్ధి చేయండి.

symptoms: Leaves start to turn a pale green color.
A cottony white growth appears on the leaves.
The leaves slowly change from pale yellow to dark brown.
Finally the infected leaves dry up and die.

discriminators.question: Do the leaves turn pale green with a white cotton-like growth on them, without dark spots?

diseases.favourable_conditions: Warm and humid weather helps this disease grow.
prevention: Choose healthy bulbs when you are saving seeds.
Rotate your crops by planting something else for 3 to 4 years.
Clean up and destroy all old plant parts and trash from the field.
Use varieties that are known to resist this disease.
Expose onion bulbs meant for seeds to the sun for 12 days.
practices: Avoid planting too late in the season.
Make sure your field has good drainage.
Do not use too much fertilizer.
Avoid watering your crops too often.

avoid.text: Do not use carbendazim, or mixtures that contain it, for this disease: carbendazim does not work on water moulds (oomycetes) such as the downy mildew and late blight pathogens.

first_action.text: Keep the field drained and avoid frequent watering; next season, use healthy bulbs and rotate for 3 to 4 years.

texts.bn: জমিতে জল নিকাশের ব্যবস্থা রাখুন এবং ঘন ঘন সেচ দেবেন না। পরের মরসুমে সুস্থ কন্দ ব্যবহার করুন এবং 3 থেকে 4 বছর ফসলের আবর্তন করুন।
texts.gu: ખેતરનું પાણી કાઢી નાખો અને વારંવાર પિયત ન આપો; આવતી સીઝનમાં તંદુરસ્ત ગાંઠ વાપરો અને 3 થી 4 વર્ષ ફેરબદલી કરો.
texts.hi: खेत में पानी की निकासी रखें और बार-बार सिंचाई न करें। अगले मौसम में स्वस्थ कंद लें और 3 से 4 साल का फसल चक्र अपनाएं।
texts.kn: ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ಬಸಿದು ಹೋಗುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿ, ಪದೇ ಪದೇ ನೀರು ಹಾಯಿಸಬೇಡಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂಗಾಮಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಗಡ್ಡೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ, 3 ರಿಂದ 4 ವರ್ಷ ಬೆಳೆ ಸರದಿ ಮಾಡಿ.
texts.ml: വയലിലെ വെള്ളം വാർത്തുകളയുക, ഇടയ്ക്കിടെ നനയ്ക്കരുത്; അടുത്ത സീസണിൽ ആരോഗ്യമുള്ള ഉള്ളി ഉപയോഗിക്കുകയും 3 മുതൽ 4 വർഷം വിള മാറ്റി കൃഷി ചെയ്യുകയും ചെയ്യുക.
texts.mr: शेतातील पाण्याचा निचरा होऊ द्या आणि वारंवार पाणी देऊ नका. पुढच्या हंगामात निरोगी कांदे वापरा आणि 3 ते 4 वर्षे पीक फेरपालट करा.
texts.or: ଜମିରୁ ପାଣି ନିଷ୍କାସନ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ବାରମ୍ବାର ପାଣି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ; ଆସନ୍ତା ମରସୁମରେ ସୁସ୍ଥ ପିଆଜ ଗଣ୍ଠି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ 3 ରୁ 4 ବର୍ଷ ଫସଲ ଘୂର୍ଣ୍ଣନ କରନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਖੇਤ ਦਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਕੱਢ ਦਿਓ ਅਤੇ ਵਾਰ ਵਾਰ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾ ਲਾਓ; ਅਗਲੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤ ਗੰਢੇ ਵਰਤੋ ਅਤੇ 3 ਤੋਂ 4 ਸਾਲ ਫੇਰ-ਬਦਲ ਕਰੋ।
texts.ta: வயலில் தண்ணீர் வடிய வழி செய்து, அடிக்கடி நீர்ப்பாய்ச்சாதீர்கள். அடுத்த பருவத்தில் ஆரோக்கியமான வெங்காயங்களைப் பயன்படுத்தி 3 முதல் 4 ஆண்டுகள் பயிர் சுழற்சி செய்யுங்கள்.
texts.te: పొలంలో నీరు నిలవకుండా చూడండి, తరచూ నీరు పెట్టవద్దు. వచ్చే సీజన్‌లో ఆరోగ్యమైన గడ్డలు వాడండి, 3 నుంచి 4 సంవత్సరాలు పంట మార్పిడి చేయండి.

symptoms: You will see small white silvery patches all over the leaves.
In bad cases, the leaves start to dry out from the tip downwards.
The feeding marks show as white to silvery patches and streaks, and badly fed leaves take on a silvery look and wither.
Tiny black tar-like spots of thrips droppings can be seen on badly damaged leaves.
prevention: Keep your fields clean and free of weeds.
Use regular hoeing to disturb the soil.
practices: Check five leaves per plant to count the number of nymphs and adults.
Use blue sticky traps placed 15 cm above the crop canopy to monitor them.
You can make your own traps using empty tins painted blue and coated with grease or castor oil.

first_action.text: Count first: check five leaves per plant, and put up blue sticky traps 15 cm above the crop.

texts.bn: আগে গুনে দেখুন: প্রতি গাছের পাঁচটি পাতা দেখুন এবং ফসলের 15 cm উপরে নীল আঠালো ফাঁদ লাগান।
texts.gu: પહેલા ગણતરી કરો: છોડ દીઠ પાંચ પાન તપાસો, અને પાકથી 15 cm ઉપર વાદળી ચીકણા ટ્રેપ લગાવો.
texts.hi: पहले गिनती करें: हर पौधे की पांच पत्तियां देखें, और फसल से 15 cm ऊपर नीले चिपचिपे जाल लगाएं।
texts.kn: ಮೊದಲು ಎಣಿಸಿ: ಪ್ರತಿ ಗಿಡದ ಐದು ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ, ಬೆಳೆಯಿಂದ 15 cm ಮೇಲೆ ನೀಲಿ ಅಂಟು ಬಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹಾಕಿ.
texts.ml: ആദ്യം എണ്ണിനോക്കുക: ഒരു ചെടിയിലെ അഞ്ച് ഇലകൾ പരിശോധിക്കുക, വിളയ്ക്ക് 15 cm മുകളിൽ നീല ഒട്ടും കെണികൾ വയ്ക്കുക.
texts.mr: आधी मोजणी करा: प्रत्येक झाडाची पाच पाने तपासा आणि पिकापासून 15 cm वर निळे चिकट सापळे लावा.
texts.or: ପ୍ରଥମେ ଗଣନା କରନ୍ତୁ: ପ୍ରତି ଗଛର 5ଟି ପତ୍ର ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଫସଲଠାରୁ 15 cm ଉପରେ ନୀଳ ଆଠାଯୁକ୍ତ ଫାନ୍ଦ ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਕਰੋ: ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਬੂਟਾ ਪੰਜ ਪੱਤੇ ਜਾਂਚੋ, ਅਤੇ ਫ਼ਸਲ ਤੋਂ 15 cm ਉੱਪਰ ਨੀਲੇ ਚਿਪਚਿਪੇ ਟ੍ਰੈਪ ਲਾਓ।
texts.ta: முதலில் எண்ணுங்கள்: ஒரு செடிக்கு ஐந்து இலைகளைப் பாருங்கள், பயிருக்கு 15 cm மேலே நீல ஒட்டும் பொறிகளை வையுங்கள்.
texts.te: ముందు లెక్కపెట్టండి: మొక్కకు 5 ఆకులను చూడండి. పంట కంటే 15 సెం.మీ. ఎత్తులో నీలం జిగురు అట్టలు పెట్టండి.

diseases.pathogen: Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. cepae Schlecht
symptoms: The leaves start to turn yellow and the plant stops growing well.
The leaves begin to dry out starting from the tip and moving downward.
Early on, the roots turn pink and eventually start to rot.
The bulb begins to rot from the bottom end.
The entire plant will die in the later stages of the disease.
diseases.favourable_conditions: Moist soil and a temperature of 27 degrees Celsius help the disease to grow.
prevention: Rotate your crops every 4 to 5 years using plants that do not host this disease.
Plant tobacco or sorghum with your onions to help reduce the disease.
Use a plastic sheet to cover and heat the soil during the summer for 30 days.
Choose onion varieties that are known to resist this disease.
Be careful not to injure the plants while working in the field.
practices: Make sure your field has good drainage to keep water from sitting.
Perform deep ploughing during the summer.
Flood the soil during the time of year when you are not growing crops.

texts.bn: জমিতে জল নিকাশের ব্যবস্থা রাখুন। পরের মরসুমে 4 থেকে 5 বছর ফসলের আবর্তন করুন এবং প্রতিরোধী জাত বেছে নিন।
texts.gu: ખેતરનું પાણી કાઢી નાખો; આવતી સીઝનમાં 4 થી 5 વર્ષ ફેરબદલી કરો અને પ્રતિકારક જાત પસંદ કરો.
texts.hi: खेत में पानी की निकासी रखें। अगले मौसम में 4 से 5 साल का फसल चक्र अपनाएं और प्रतिरोधी किस्म चुनें।
texts.kn: ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ಬಸಿದು ಹೋಗುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂಗಾಮಿನಲ್ಲಿ 4 ರಿಂದ 5 ವರ್ಷ ಬೆಳೆ ಸರದಿ ಮಾಡಿ, ನಿರೋಧಕ ತಳಿ ಆರಿಸಿ.
texts.ml: വയലിലെ വെള്ളം വാർത്തുകളയുക; അടുത്ത സീസണിൽ 4 മുതൽ 5 വർഷം വിള മാറ്റി കൃഷി ചെയ്യുകയും രോഗം ചെറുക്കുന്ന ഇനം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുക.
texts.mr: शेतातील पाण्याचा निचरा होऊ द्या. पुढच्या हंगामात 4 ते 5 वर्षे पीक फेरपालट करा आणि प्रतिकारक वाण निवडा.
texts.or: ଜମିରୁ ପାଣି ନିଷ୍କାସନ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଆସନ୍ତା ମରସୁମରେ 4 ରୁ 5 ବର୍ଷ ଫସଲ ଘୂର୍ଣ୍ଣନ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧୀ ପ୍ରଜାତି ବାଛନ୍ତୁ।
texts.pa: ਖੇਤ ਦਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਕੱਢ ਦਿਓ; ਅਗਲੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ 4 ਤੋਂ 5 ਸਾਲ ਫੇਰ-ਬਦਲ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਰੋਧਕ ਕਿਸਮ ਚੁਣੋ।
texts.ta: வயலில் தண்ணீர் வடிய வழி செய்யுங்கள். அடுத்த பருவத்தில் 4 முதல் 5 ஆண்டுகள் பயிர் சுழற்சி செய்து, எதிர்ப்பு ரகத்தைத் தேர்ந்தெடுங்கள்.
texts.te: పొలంలో నీరు నిలవకుండా చూడండి. వచ్చే సీజన్‌లో 4 నుంచి 5 సంవత్సరాలు పంట మార్పిడి చేయండి, తట్టుకునే రకం ఎంచుకోండి.

symptoms: Leaves are evenly green for the variety, with no spots, streaks, rings or powdery coating.
Leaf edges and tips are not curling, yellowing, drying or burnt.
There are no insects, eggs, webbing, holes or bore marks on the leaves, stems or fruits.
prevention: Choose a variety that resists or tolerates the main pests and diseases, and use healthy seed or planting material.
Treat seed or planting material before sowing, preferably with a bio-pesticide.
Keep proper spacing, give organic manure and fertiliser by soil test, and avoid too much nitrogen, which makes the crop soft and easy for pests and diseases to attack.
Water the crop properly and rotate crops from season to season.
practices: Walk through the field at least once a week and look at the soil, water, plants, pests and the friendly insects that eat pests.
Look after the friendly insects and spiders by avoiding broad-spectrum chemical sprays.
Act early when you see trouble, for example by collecting egg masses or removing infested plants.
